Dragons: Rescue Riders: Huttsgalor Holiday. Snowfall marks the start of Odinyule — the Viking holiday of giving! But crazy weather might cancel the tradition unless the Rescue Riders can swoop in.
Tell Me When. Workaholic Will puts his humdrum life in LA on hold to fulfill his grandpa's last wish: visiting Mexico City's most iconic sights and falling in love.
Trial By Media. In this true crime docuseries, some of the most dramatic trials of all time are examined with an emphasis on how the media may have impacted verdicts.
Dracula. The Count Dracula legend transforms with new tales that flesh out the vampire's gory crimes – and bring his vulnerability into the light.
Silicon Cowboys. This documentary tells the story of Compaq Computer and its three founders, who in 1982, took on Goliath IBM at the height of its PC dominance.
My Scientology Movie. After speaking with former Scientology members and being stonewalled by higher-ups, filmmaker Louis Theroux hires actors to re-create alleged events.
Daughter From Another Mother. After realizing their babies were exchanged at birth, two women develop a plan to adjust to their new lives: creating a single —and peculiar— family.
Beyond Skyline. In the wake of an extraterrestrial invasion, a suspended L.A. cop teams up with survivors to stop the onslaught and rescue human captives.
Chocolate. Brought together by meaningful meals in the past and present, a doctor and a chef are reacquainted when they begin working at a hospice ward.
Zindagi Gulzar Hai. Strong-willed, middle-class Kashaf and carefree, wealthy Zaroon meet in college, but before love can take root, they each have some growing up to do.
Forces of Nature. This dynamic series spans the globe to explain the complex natural forces that govern the planet, from shape and color to motion and the elements.
Beasts of No Nation. When civil war tears his family apart, a young West African boy is forced to join a unit of mercenary fighters and transform into a child soldier.
Atlantics. Arranged to marry a rich man, young Ada is crushed when her true love goes missing at sea during a migration attempt – until a miracle reunites them.
B.A. Pass. Orphaned and at loose ends, young Mukesh falls into the seductive orbit of married Sarika, who leads him ever deeper into a world of sex and betrayal.
Catch Me If You Can. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put cunning con man Frank Abagnale Jr. behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.
Boys Over Flowers. Unassuming high school girl Jan-di stands up to – and eventually falls for – a spoiled rich kid who belongs to the school's most powerful clique.
Ready to Mingle. After the man she thought she'd marry breaks up with her, Ana joins a class for single women who are in search of a husband.
Gardeners of Eden. As corrupt governments fail to stop the slaughter of elephants for ivory, an 80-year-old woman and a crew of rangers bravely try to end the poaching.

titulo: Club de Cuervos Presents: The Ballad of Hugo Sánchez
texto: Club de Cuervos Presents: The Ballad of Hugo Sánchez. Chava Iglesias's doting personal assistant Hugo Sánchez is tasked with leading Club de Cuervos to victory in Nicaragua – if only his mom will let him.
Todo Sobre El Asado. This quirky examination of Argentina's culture, customs and cuisine slices into the country's traditional barbecue – which is both meal and ritual.
Onaatah. Seeking to heal after a traumatic assault, a young woman retreats to a small village by the hills, where she finds hope, love and new purpose.
November Criminals. Dissatisfied with the police’s progress, a teen and his best friend investigate their classmate's murder, treading down a dark path to the uneasy truth.
Abdo Mota. Following the mysterious death of his parents, a young man finds himself enmeshed in the dark world of drugs and crime.
Moesha. Navigating the twists and firsts of high school, Moesha juggles friendships, romance and the occasional drama while trying to keep her family together.
The Resurrection of Gavin Stone. After one too many run-ins with the law, a Hollywood bad boy finds redemption while fulfilling his court-ordered community service at a megachurch.
Leyla and Mecnun. Destiny brings Mecnun and Leyla together as newborns, and again years later. Despite unexpected turns in Mecnun's zany life, Leyla remains a constant.
After Porn Ends 3. This third installment in a documentary series examines the lives of the adult film genre's biggest stars after their industry careers have ended.

titulo: The Mr. Peabody and Sherman Show
texto: The Mr. Peabody and Sherman Show. Mr. Peabody and Sherman host a zany late-night comedy show from a swanky penthouse, with time-traveling historical figures and a live audience.
Ibiza. When Harper is sent to Spain for an important work meeting, her hard-partying friends tag along and convince her to pursue a fling with a famous DJ.
Superlopez. In this adaptation of the comic strip, Juan López must balance an office job with heroic feats to save the love of his life and native planet Chitón.
They've Gotta Have Us. Powered by candid recollections from esteemed African-American entertainers, this docuseries traces the history of black cinema.
Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyan. Explore the history and flavors of regional Indian cuisine, from traditional Kashmiri feasts to the vegetarian dishes of Gujarat.
A Home with A View. When a neighbor blocks their view of the city with a commercial billboard, a Hong Kong family resorts to drastic, imaginative measures to take it down.
Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted. Next stop: New York! But to get back home, Alex and friends must hitch a ride with a traveling European circus and evade an evil animal-control officer.
Extremis. Witness the wrenching emotions that accompany end-of-life decisions as doctors, patients and families in a hospital ICU face harrowing choices.
Asperger's Are Us. A comedy troupe of four friends on the autism spectrum prepares for a final show before its members go their separate ways.
What a Girl Wants. In search of the father she's never met, the daughter of a bohemian American woman heads to Europe and finds that her dad is an uptight politician.
Strong Island. The forces of family, grief and racial injustice converge in this powerful documentary exploring the murder of filmmaker Yance Ford's brother.
I Am Sun Mu. A North Korean propagandist who escaped to Seoul now creates satirical art about Kim Jong Il's regime and copes with repercussions of his defection.
Drunk Parents. Two desperate parents go to extreme lengths to hide their dire financial straits from their daughter and friends.
The Queen's Gambit. In a 1950s orphanage, a young girl reveals an astonishing talent for chess and begins an unlikely journey to stardom while grappling with addiction.
Alien Worlds. Applying the laws of life on Earth to the rest of the galaxy, this series blends science fact and fiction to imagine alien life on other planets.
Outside the Wire. In the near future, a drone pilot sent into a war zone finds himself paired with a top-secret android officer on a mission to stop a nuclear attack.
Big Fat Liar. Junior high students Jason and Kaylee take action when a greedy Hollywood producer turns Jason's essay into a hit film without giving him credit.
Striptease. A former FBI employee works as a stripper to finance her custody battle for her daughter when a secretly shady congressman takes an interest in her.
Power Rangers Operation Overdrive. To keep powerful jewels from falling into the hands of two wicked brothers, five young Power Rangers set out on a dangerous global adventure.
Thieves of the Wood. Charismatic highwayman Jan de Lichte leads the oppressed and downtrodden in a revolt against the corrupt aristocracy of 18th-century Flanders.
Little Singham: Legend of Dugabakka. As fears rise over a ghost known for nighttime abductions, Mirchi Nagar residents look to the only person they know can save them: Little Singham!

titulo: My Babysitter's a Vampire: The Movie
texto: My Babysitter's a Vampire: The Movie. When their parents head out for the evening, Ethan and his little sister get the babysitter of their nightmares: a fledgling vampire named Sarah.
LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha. This provocative drama examines how the voyeuristic nature of modern society affects three unusual couples in Northern India.
Toll Booth. A toll booth operator's mundane life is upended when he's reassigned to a remote spot, where he finds intriguing strangers — and a new side to himself.
The Sky Is Pink. After succumbing to her terminal illness, a teenager posthumously narrates her parents’ tenacious relationship in this drama based on a true story.
Clash. When the patriarch of an emigrant Nigerian family visits their female-led Canadian home, traditional values collide with newer ones.
Basic Instinct. A detective investigating a rock star's brutal murder becomes drawn to the prime suspect — a mysterious novelist whose recent book mirrors the crime.
This Is Pop. Uncover the real stories behind your favorite pop songs as this docuseries charts the impact of the festival scene, Auto-Tune, boy bands and more.
Black Friday. This docudrama based on the same-titled book tracks the aftermath of a 1993 bombing in Bombay through the eyes of a journalist covering the story.
Runaway Bride. Sparks fly when a newspaper columnist writes a one-sided, sexist story about a commitment-phobic bride who abandoned three men at the altar.
Dostana. To win over a landlady who only accepts women as tenants, two men pose as a couple – but the jig may be up when they both fall for their flatmate.
Fauda. A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian militant he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.
Seriously Single. While her free-living bestie urges her to embrace singlehood, a commitment-craving social media expert can't stop following the life of a former love.
Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster Returns. Knotty love triangles and nefarious schemes arise when a nobleman’s plans to remarry fall into the cunning hands of his first wife and a vengeful rival.
Midnight Diner: Tokyo Stories. Patrons of an otherwise mundane Japanese diner find simple yet profound connections with one another based on the shared love of a particular dish.
Ma Chu Ka. The relationship between a journalist and a lawyer she meets while investigating a story grows complicated as she uncovers layers of deception.
A Beautiful Life. After meeting under awkward circumstances, a glamorous businesswoman and a tradition-bound policeman begin a relationship that changes their lives.
Julius Jr.. Paul Frank's fun artwork comes to life in this show that follows monkey Julius Jr. and his friends as they explore the world and help each other out.
Villain. Fresh out of prison, an ex-con tries to save his debt-ridden brother and the family pub until local mobsters draw him back to a criminal underworld.
Warrior Nun. After waking up in a morgue, an orphaned teen discovers she now possesses superpowers as the chosen Halo-Bearer for a secret sect of demon-hunting nuns.
Leo the Lion. Eschewing the carnivorous ways of his fellow lions, maverick Leo follows a vegetarian diet – causing the other lions to shun him.
The Letdown. Audrey, mother of a 2-month-old, joins a new-parents support group, where she makes some quirky friends facing various challenges and life changes.
Frozen Planet. Go on a journey through the Arctic and Antarctic with this visually stunning program that explores these wildernesses and their inhabitants.
Kyaa Kool Hain Hum 3. When an unlikely porn actor falls for a woman outside the industry, he employs his co-stars as a stand-in traditional family to impress her father.

titulo: Days We Stared at the Sun
texto: Days We Stared at the Sun. A model student resorts to violence after witnessing greed and corruption wreak havoc on his life.
Mystic River. Haunted by a monstrous crime, three childhood friends in Boston cross paths again decades later in connection with a murder investigation.
Disco Dancer. A poor boy grows up to be a famous disco dancer, hoping to use his art to exact revenge on the millionaire who once framed him and his mother for theft.
6 Days. When armed gunmen seize the Iranian Embassy in 1980, a tense six-day standoff ensues while elite British soldiers prepare for a dangerous raid.
Romance Doll. Love came naturally for married couple Sonoko and Tetsuo. But his secret profession as a love doll designer clashes with her deeper, darker secret.
Umrika. An ambitious man leaves his small Indian village for America. But when his letters to home stop coming, his brother sets out on his own adventure.
Locust. A torrid affair between a passionate lowborn poet and a wealthy Moscow heiress is engulfed by class difference, criminality and, eventually, murder.
The Paramedic. Unable to face his new reality in a wheelchair, Ángel develops a deadly obsession with the woman who left him and unleashes a sinister revenge plot.
Swami. After she enters into an arranged marriage, a spirited and intellectual young woman tries to adjust to life with a man who was not her choice.
Larceny. An ex-CIA contractor turned thief is forced to head a CIA gambit to infiltrate a black ops Mexican prison and steal $50 million in drug cartel money.
Tremors 3: Back to Perfection. When a theme park's simulated giant worm attacks turn real, Burt Gummer and two young entrepreneurs team up to battle the flesh-eating graboids.
Chewin' the Fat. Petty criminals, dodgy decorators, full-bore Glaswegians and oddball documentary presenters converge in this sketch show that parodies Scottish life.
Mommy Issues. Close quarters and new romances add trouble to the rocky relationship between a high-strung young woman and her demanding mother.
Growing Up Coy. Filmmakers follow a Colorado family's highly public battle for the rights of their transgender daughter, Coy, in a landmark civil rights case.
John Day. A bank manager and his wife, still grieving over their daughter who died in a fire, become pawns in a bank heist with ties to corruption and fraud.
Master of None. Dev tries to jump-start his acting career and elevate his dating game with help from his eclectic group of friends in this award-winning series.
The Legend of Bhagat Singh. This biopic chronicles the life and times of iconic Indian revolutionary Bhagat Singh, who led an armed resistance against the British in the 1920.

titulo: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga
texto: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga. As her family seeks to marry her off and a hopeful writer pursues her, a small-town woman struggles to reveal the long-hidden truth about who she loves.
Black Lightning. School principal and retired superhero Jefferson Pierce leaps back into action as the legendary Black Lightning after a gang threatens his family.
Mona Lisa Smile. In 1953, the women of Wellesley College are measured by how well they marry – until the arrival of a professor who threatens to upend the status quo.
Unabomber - In His Own Words. The CIA attempts to turn Ted Kaczynski, aka the Unabomber, into a super agent — a plan that backfires. Based on real events.
Over Christmas. Down-and-out musician Bastian battles the blues as he returns home for Christmas and encounters a series of not-so-cheery surprises.

titulo: Martin Luther: The Idea that Changed the World
texto: Martin Luther: The Idea that Changed the World. This docudrama tells the dramatic story of the monk who took on the Catholic Church, tracing his life before and after the contentious "95 Theses."
The Gathering. Between divorce, bad relationships and coming out as gay, a group of affluent friends realize that none of their lives are as easy as they seem.

titulo: My Love: Six Stories of True Love
texto: My Love: Six Stories of True Love. Six longtime couples in different parts of the world share their decades-long love in these tender portraits filmed over the course of one year.
Gridlocked. An embittered cop is tasked with baby-sitting a spoiled actor, but the two must learn to fight together when they run afoul of a group of mercenaries.

titulo: We Are All For The Fatherland
texto: We Are All For The Fatherland. After the 1978 Israeli invasion of Lebanon, children try to sing the national anthem as citizens search for hope in the war-torn South.
Ungli. An undercover cop finds himself in a strange position after infiltrating a "gang" that pulls wildly popular pranks on corrupt officials in Mumbai.
Murderous Affairs. Mixing interviews with dramatic re-enactments, this series focuses on lethal love affairs and spouses driven to murder.
City of Joy. Women who've been sexually brutalized in war-torn Congo begin to heal at City of Joy, a center that helps them regain a sense of self and empowerment.
Race to Witch Mountain. A sister and brother with special powers are on the run from a mysterious organization that wants to take advantage of the siblings' gifts.
OtherLife. After inventing a drug that induces time-compressed virtual realities, young Ren grapples with partner Sam over how to use their powerful creation.
Chippa. At midnight on his 10th birthday, a boy scours the lesser-known Kolkata streets in search of a father he’s never met, carrying a letter he can’t read.
Crazy Beautiful You. A rebellious daughter accompanies her mother on a medical mission where she falls for the handsome politician's son assigned to be her chaperone.
Fakta Ladh Mhana. A young man enlists the help of his friends to avenge his uncle's death by taking on a powerful, unscrupulous politician.
The Fisherman's Diary. Inspired by Nobel Peace Prize winner Malala Yousafzai, a young girl defies the expectations of her father and village to pursue an education
Inside The Freemasons. Explore the history and future of the Freemasons, a fraternal order steeped in both secrecy and tradition.
Rezeta. Gorgeous and free-spirited Albanian model Rezeta arrives in Mexico City, and soon uses her charms to take up a carefree new life in the metropolis.
Arrow. Based on DC Comics' Green Arrow, an affluent playboy becomes a vengeful superhero, saving the city from villains armed with just a bow and arrows.
Intrusion. After a deadly home invasion at a couple’s new dream house, the traumatized wife searches for answers — and learns the real danger is just beginning.
Superfly. To get away from the thug life, cocaine dealer Youngblood Priest puts together one last deal that will net him enough money to start over.
Flower Girl. When a young florist who's long dreamed of her wedding day gets dumped by her boyfriend, she sets out to win him back with help from a handsome actor.
Kahlil Gibran's The Prophet. A troubled young girl and her mother find solace on a journey with a subversive poet whose words captivate their hearts and imaginations.
Bobby. Raj, the son of strict, wealthy parents, falls in love with Bobby, the daughter of a poor Christian fisherman – a romance his parents oppose.
Penguin Bloom. As a mom copes with the aftermath of a harrowing accident, she finds inspiration from an injured magpie taken in by her family. Based on a true story.
Clouds of Sils Maria. A middle-aged actress is cast in a film adaptation of the play that made her famous 20 years earlier, but in a much less glamorous role.
Daddy Day Care. When a conscientious father loses his lucrative dot-com job and faces economic ruin, he joins two friends in opening a business called Daddy Day Care.
Yeh Hai Bakrapur. A poor family’s goat suddenly acquires divine status, sparking a widespread frenzy as everyone clamors to benefit from its unexpected celebrity.
The Happytime Murders. In an LA where puppets and humans coexist, a down-on-his-luck detective teams with his ex-partner to nab a killer targeting the cast of an old TV show.
The Spiderwick Chronicles. When city-raised twins move to a tumbledown country mansion, it's quite an adjustment – especially after they uncover a magical fantasy world.
Tony Parker: The Final Shot. This film examines the background and career of Tony Parker, whose determination led him to become arguably the greatest French basketball player.
Stink!. After noting a strange odor in his child’s pajamas, a single dad’s search for the source uncovers potentially toxic secrets of the chemical industry.
Hook. Despite their fathers' rivalry, two university students form a friendship at a boxing gym as they tackle family drama, romance and personal crises.

titulo: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
texto: The Killing of a Sacred Deer. A surgeon's carefully curated life edges toward disaster when a troubled teenage boy with mysterious motives begins to impose himself on his family.
Happy Valley. Yorkshire police sergeant Catherine Cawood pursues the man who assaulted her late daughter, unaware he is now part of a secret kidnapping plot.
Mahmut & Meryem. In the 16th century, the heir to a Muslim empire embarks on a dangerous journey to find his true love, who was taken away by her Christian father.

titulo: Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak
texto: Pandemic: How to Prevent an Outbreak. In this docuseries, meet the heroes on the front lines of the battle against influenza and learn about their efforts to stop the next global outbreak.
Friendsgiving. A quiet holiday dinner among friends turns into a chaotic night of illicit activity and compromising situations when uninvited guests crash the party.
Krystal. A kid with a heart condition falls for an ex-stripper with a lot of baggage and joins her Alcoholics Anonymous group to catch her attention.
Who Killed Little Gregory?. When their 4-year-old son is murdered, a young couple fights a twisting and arduous battle trying to identify a frustratingly elusive killer.
Miss Sharon Jones!. This uplifting documentary follows R&B singer Sharon Jones's battle with pancreatic cancer while keeping her band intact for a return to the stage.
Kon Kon Kon. Explore the stories of ordinary people dealing with extraordinary circumstances in this series that focuses on overcoming obstacles and odds.
End of Watch. Officers Taylor and Zavala patrol the streets of South Central Los Angeles, an area of the city ruled by gangs and riddled with drug violence.
Mr. Iglesias. Hilarious high school teacher Gabriel Iglesias tries to make a difference in the lives of some smart but underperforming students at his alma mater.
Devil's Bride. On a small Finnish island in 1666, a teenage girl in love with a married fisherman becomes the center of a tragic witch hunt and power struggle.
Yours Fatefully. Two lonely singles meet on a blind date and slowly get to know each other, unaware that their parents are friends and may be falling in love.
Mega Food. Visiting the busiest kitchens in the world, this reality series focuses on large-scale food production – and the people who make it happen.

titulo: Club Friday To Be Continued - My Beautiful Tomboy
texto: Club Friday To Be Continued - My Beautiful Tomboy. A change in sexual identity complicates young Meen's relationships, while memories of a past romance remain fresh.
The Coldest Game. During 1962’s Cuban missile crisis, a troubled math genius finds himself drafted to play in a U.S.-Soviet chess match – and a deadly game of espionage.
Dark Tourist. From a nuclear lake to a haunted forest, journalist David Farrier visits unusual – and often macabre – tourism spots around the world.
Lift Like a Girl. With the guidance of her relentless coach, a teen weightlifter emerges from a scrappy training camp in Egypt to compete at the championship level.
Spectral. When an otherworldly force wreaks havoc on a war-torn European city, an engineer teams up with an elite Special Ops unit to stop it.
Bombay Begums. From boardrooms to society's margins, five ambitious women from various walks of life navigate dreams, desires and disappointments in modern Mumbai.
The African Doctor. Happily escaping a dictatorship, a Congolese doctor transplants his family to a small French village, where culture shock sets in for everyone.
Saath Saath. A young woman falls for her classmate’s idealistic, non-materialistic ways, but is troubled upon seeing his principles change after they marry.
Kasanova. After losing his wife, a single father indulges in flimsy flings until he meets his son's music teacher, who imparts a few lessons on love.
The Royal Bengal Tiger. Knocked down by life one too many times, a meek family man drastically transforms from shy to savage after an encounter with a mysterious friend.
The Free Man. Olympic freestyle skier Jossi Wells learns the dangerous extreme sport of highlining with help from death-defying daredevils the Flying Frenchies.
Incoming. When an imprisoned terrorist cell hijacks a high-security prison in outer space, a CIA agent becomes the one chance of stopping them.
C/O Kaadhal. Cutting across conventions and expectations, four brave love stories blossom in this Tamil remake of the 2018 Telugu film "Care of Kancharapalem.”
Death Can Wait. After learning he may die soon, a modest accountant pulls off a shady money scheme and heads to Europe, where he's faced with a life-or-death situation.
Concrete Cowboy. Sent to live with his estranged father for the summer, a rebellious teen finds kinship in a tight-knit Philadelphia community of Black cowboys.
Enlighten Us. This documentary digs deep to recount the saga of the superstar self-help guru convicted of negligent homicide in the deaths of three followers.
Then Came You. A hypochondriac confronts his fear of death when a terminally ill teen girl enlists him to help her complete her bucket list.

titulo: Sophie: A Murder in West Cork
texto: Sophie: A Murder in West Cork. A shocking murder in rural Ireland sets off an increasingly convoluted quest for justice that spans decades and cuts across national borders.
Border Security: America's Front Line. This reality series chronicles the behind-the-scenes action as U.S. Customs and Border Protection agents safeguard the nation's crossings and ports.
The Shaukeens. Three sexually frustrated men in their 60s have the adventure of a lifetime after meeting an intriguing young woman during a holiday in Mauritius.
Camarón: The Film. This documentary looks back on the life of legendary flamenco singer Camarón, who went from humble roots to rock star status to a tragic early death.
The Girl and the Gun. Fed up with abuse by those around her, a department store saleswoman finds a weapon in an alleyway and decides to settle scores.
Angry Birds. Birds Red, Chuck and their feathered friends have lots of adventures while guarding eggs in their nest that pesky pigs keep trying to steal.
Yeh Ballet. Discovered by an eccentric ballet master, two gifted but underprivileged Mumbai teens face bigotry and disapproval as they pursue their dancing dreams.
Castle and Castle. A pair of high-powered, successful lawyers find themselves defending opposite interests of the justice system, causing a strain on their happy marriage.

titulo: Lo and Behold: Reveries of the Connected World
texto: Lo and Behold: Reveries of the Connected World. Filmmaker Werner Herzog presents a history of the internet, starting with its birth in 1969, and ponders the joys and sorrows of its social influence.
Pretville. A farm boy and a greaser pluck at the heartstrings of their town's most beloved daughter while her mom faces old feelings when a pop star comes home.
Worn Stories. In this funny, heartfelt and moving docuseries, real people unpack the fascinating and quirky stories around their most meaningful pieces of clothing.
Nature: Raising the Dinosaur Giant. Sir David Attenborough examines a recently discovered collection of dinosaur fossils. CGI and 3-D scans reveal what the beast may have looked like.
Teshan. New beginnings appear to be on the horizon after a simple country boy forms a bond with a sophisticated urban girl with modern ideas.
Professor Mack. When a confident college professor is courted by four eligible and well-established men, she struggles to decide who she likes the best.
Kulipari: An Army of Frogs. In a tale of bravery and heroism, fearless frogs go to war against the sinister scorpions and spiders that have teamed up to conquer the amphibians.
I Called Him Morgan. Decades after serving a prison sentence for killing jazz musician Lee Morgan, his common-law wife, Helen, reflects on their lives and his legacy.
V.R. Troopers. Three friends who study martial arts find themselves defending humanity from a criminal mastermind and his invading army from another dimension.

titulo: A Grand Night In: The Story of Aardman
texto: A Grand Night In: The Story of Aardman. Aardman Animations icons Wallace & Gromit, Morph and more join fans and collaborators for a retrospective celebrating the studio's 40th anniversary.
The Ranch. Being a pro athlete didn't pan out for Colt. Now he's helping his dad and brother keep the ranch afloat, and figuring out how he fits into the family.
Dragonkala Ka Rahasya. Bheem helps to reopen Dragonpur's abandoned magic and martial arts school, but is tested like never before when an ex-student returns seeking revenge!
An Innocent Mistake. Raised by three mothers, a self-assured teen in turmoil meets the father figure she never had. But she also stands to drive the man and his son apart.
Blood Father. An ex-convict and estranged father finds the chance to prove himself when his daughter seeks his help shaking off a dangerous group of drug dealers.
Ankahi Kahaniya. As big city life buzzes around them, lonely souls discover surprising sources of connection and companionship in three tales of love, loss and longing.
Ip Man 3. Martial arts master Ip springs into action when his son's school is threatened by a shady American, then defends his status as wing chun champion.
A StoryBots Space Adventure. Join the StoryBots and the space travelers of the historic Inspiration4 mission as they search for answers to kids' questions about space.
Moxie. Inspired by her mom's rebellious past and a confident new friend, a shy 16-year-old publishes an anonymous zine calling out sexism at her school.
Daybreak. Living his best life in post-apocalyptic LA, a slacker strives to find the girl of his dreams while outwitting mindless ghouls and cliquish gangs.

titulo: Late Life: The Chien-Ming Wang Story
texto: Late Life: The Chien-Ming Wang Story. Injuries sidelined the bright career of New York Yankees pitcher Chien-Ming Wang. This documentary captures his relentless battle back to the majors.
Holly Star. Home for the holidays, a broke puppeteer knows there’s treasure buried somewhere under her town. To find it, all she has to do is die – almost.
Christmas Break-In. Stranded at school before holiday break, a precocious girl gets into the spirit of saving when a trio of robbers trespass and hold the janitor hostage.
Walk of Shame. After a night of boozy carousing, a local newscaster finds herself stranded on the streets of LA just hours before the job interview of a lifetime.
Wild Wild Country. When a controversial cult leader builds a utopian city in the Oregon desert, conflict with the locals escalates into a national scandal.
Grandmaster. Anticipating the next move in a serial killer's grisly game, a police chief realizes that his daughter and estranged wife are the next likely victims.
Déjà Vu. After losing everything, a prima ballerina accepts a stranger's offer to dial back time and reclaim what was taken from her – but at a great price.
Dangerous Roads. Using various 4x4 vehicles, celebrities steer their way across some of the most infamous roads and trickiest terrains on earth.
The Love Affair. Feeling betrayed by their romantic partners' infidelity, Adrianne and Vince struggle to forgive while finding comfort with each other.
Death at a Funeral. When a Los Angeles family's patriarch dies, his dutiful eldest son plans the funeral – which becomes a fiasco thanks to a colorful cast of attendees.

titulo: Through My Father's Eyes: The Ronda Rousey Story
texto: Through My Father's Eyes: The Ronda Rousey Story. This documentary chronicles former Olympian and UFC champion Ronda Rousey's ascent to iconic status in the world of mixed martial arts.
7 Yards: The Chris Norton Story. The true story of former college football player Chris Norton, who defied the odds after a devastating accident — with the woman he loves by his side.
He Never Died. A reclusive immortal who needs human flesh but tries to stay clean finds himself cast back into society by a gang of thugs and his estranged daughter.
Bulbul Can Sing. Exploring their sexual identities in the face of the patriarchal rules of their Assamese village, a teenager and her two friends are rocked by tragedy.
Fukrey Boyzzz. A troublemaking trio dreams big, plays hard and stirs up all sorts of classroom mischief in this animated spinoff of the popular Hindi film franchise.
Kalek Shanab. After a wild night of partying on the town, three buddies wake up to discover they've caused a whole mess of trouble — but can't remember how.
Black Snake Moan. Lazarus finds Rae beaten and near death, and acts as a father figure to help redeem her. But before saving anyone, Lazarus must face his own demons.
Midnight Special. When his son exhibits supernatural powers, a father takes the youngster on the run to protect him from government authorities and religious fanatics.
The Indian in the Cupboard. A boy receives a wooden cupboard, antique keys and an Iroquois warrior figurine for his birthday. The figurine comes to life overnight in the cabinet.
The Artist. Winner of five Oscars, this black-and-white silent film follows the romance between a silent-era legend on a downward spiral and a rising starlet.
Catching the Sun. This documentary explores the worldwide economics of the burgeoning solar energy industry and its impact on hopeful job seekers in the United States.
The Price of Success. Struggling to balance family ties and a career, a rising comedian of Parisian banlieue roots learns the true price of fame.
Satu Hari. A man haunted by his wife's affair moves to Sarajevo and starts to love again, until fate forces him to choose between his new life and old loyalty.
Grand Hotel. To learn the truth about his sister's mysterious disappearance, a young man infiltrates a hotel in the guise of a footman and begins an investigation.
Uncorked. A young man feels torn between his dream of becoming a master sommelier and his father’s expectations that he’ll take over the family barbecue business.
Hit & Run. A man searching for the truth behind his wife's death becomes caught up in a dangerous web of secrets and intrigue stretching from New York to Tel Aviv.
Heaven Without People. From long resentments to deep secrets, an overdue family reunion erupts with drama when the matriarch makes a disturbing discovery.
Riphagen - The Untouchable. This biopic profiles Andries Riphagen, a Dutch criminal who blackmailed Jews in hiding during World War II and was responsible for hundreds of deaths.
Emily in Paris. After landing her dream job in Paris, Chicago marketing exec Emily Cooper embraces her adventurous new life while juggling work, friends and romance.

titulo: My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games
texto: My Little Pony Equestria Girls: Friendship Games. Rainbow Dash, Applejack and friends compete against Crystal Prep Academy and their lead athlete, this world's Twilight Sparkle, in sporting events.
Anwar. Seeking refuge in a Hindu temple after the tragic death of the girl he loved, a Muslim youth is caught by the police, who mistake him for an enemy.
Black & Privileged: Volume 1. When low-income families move into a thriving black community in Chicago, they find themselves at odds with politicians to maintain their status.
Duck Duck Goose. As his flock's annual migration nears, a carefree goose is grounded with an injury and takes a pair of lost ducklings under his wing.

Y.M.I.: Yeh Mera India. The lives of a middle-aged soap opera addict, an ambitious career woman, a fervent activist and nine others from different walks of Indian life intersect in Mumbai. But this vibrant melting pot threatens to bubble over with bias and bigotry.

titulo: Michael Bolton's Big, Sexy Valentine's Day Special
texto: Michael Bolton's Big, Sexy Valentine's Day Special. After Santa tells him he needs 75,000 new babies by Christmas to meet toy supply, Michael Bolton hosts a telethon to inspire the world to make love.
America's Book of Secrets. This engaging documentary series shares the surprising backstories of familiar institutions like the Pentagon, West Point and the Playboy Mansion.
The Kissing Booth. When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.
Darra. After returning from school and getting married, a popular farmer begins to arouse resentment and jealousy among those around him.
The Outcasts. After failing to strike a truce with their school's queen bee, two misfit best friends lead a nerd uprising that turns social hierarchy on its head.
Playing for Time. Captured by Nazis and sent to Auschwitz, a Jewish musician is assigned to soothe other prisoners marching to their deaths in the gas chambers.
The King's Avatar. When an elite gamer is forced out of his professional team, he becomes a manager of an Internet café and reinvents himself to return to online glory.
Feel Good. Stand-up comic Mae Martin navigates a passionate, messy new relationship with her girlfriend, George, while dealing with the challenges of sobriety.
We Are Family. A divorced mother of three children runs a happy household – until her former husband brings his new career-oriented girlfriend into the picture.
Dil Se. A radio broadcaster's intense attraction to a mysterious woman opens the door to a tidal wave of powerful emotions and desires.
In Between. An author having trouble finishing his new romance novel because he's lost faith in love regains his romantic soul after meeting a flight attendant.
Team America: World Police. In this musical satire, an all-marionette police force takes on the challenging role of keeping the peace on a troubled planet.
The Net. A computer analyst becomes a target after she stumbles onto a conspiracy via a mysterious floppy disk, forcing her to go on the run to clear her name.
Girlfriend's Day. When he's caught up in a deadly conspiracy, an unemployed greeting card writer must create the perfect card for a new holiday to save his skin.
Bill Hicks: Reflections. This documentary about comedian Bill Hicks offers insight into his irreverent takes on, well, everything. Brother Steve Hicks is the star witness.
Ken Burns: The West. Historian Ken Burns and his team bring to life the challenges Americans faced in the 19th century as they embarked on westward expansion.
Live Up To Your Name. Pushed together by twists of time, a Joseon doctor and a cardiac surgeon overcome their 400-year divide as they learn and heal through each other.
Black Hawk Down. When U.S. forces attempt to capture two underlings of a Somali warlord, their helicopters are shot down and the Americans suffer heavy casualties.
Singapore. When his employee disappears in Singapore, Shyam travels from India to investigate the absence and becomes entangled in a deadly plot.
Battlefield Earth. In the year 3000, an alien race known as the Psychlos devastate planet Earth and force the surviving human population into slavery.
Unruly Friends. A young woman discovers that familial and psychological traumas can be difficult to leave behind.
1 Mile to You. After escaping the bus accident that killed his girlfriend, a high school student channels his grief into running, with the help of a new coach.
Africa. This five-part nature series chronicles fascinating stories of survival on the African continent, home to the most diverse animal life on the planet.
Thunderbolt. A P-47 Thunderbolt squadron is shown in preparation, at play and in bombing raids aiming to halt Nazi supply lines and aid Allied ground troops.
La diosa del asfalto. A woman from a tough neighborhood outside Mexico City comes home a rock star, inadvertently provoking a confrontation with the ghosts of her past.
Fun with Dick & Jane. After losing their high-paying corporate jobs, an upwardly mobile couple turns to robbing banks to maintain their standard of living.
Monster House. A trio of friends sets out to expose the terrors of a vacant neighborhood house, which appears to have a craving for people — and a life of its own.
Love Alarm. In a world where an app alerts people if someone in the vicinity likes them, Kim Jojo experiences young love while coping with personal adversities.
Ahista Ahista. Stood up by her groom at the altar, a young woman finds help and healing from another man – until her ex-fiancé returns, hoping to win her back.
Big Time Rush. After a talent agent discovers four talented pals and turns them into a boy band called Big Time Rush, they must adjust to their exciting new lives.
The Disciple. Self-doubt, sacrifice and struggle converge into an existential crisis for a devoted classical vocalist as the mastery he strives for remains elusive.
Trixie Mattel: Moving Parts. Drag queen Trixie Mattel deals with the bittersweet reality of success in this documentary that explores her rise to fame and subsequent music career.
Nothing to Hide. To spice up a dinner party, old friends agree to share every private message that pops up on their phones – with disastrous results.
Esperando la carroza. Cora has three sons and a daughter and she´s almost 80. One day during a family reunion the big question comes up: who will be her heir?
Secreto bien guardado. In 1940 Argentina, a Jewish 17-year-old on vacation with her family falls in love with a young Nazi lawyer staying at the same hotel.
Fate: The Winx Saga. Determined to master their enchanting powers, a group of teens navigate rivalry, romance and supernatural studies at Alfea, a magical boarding school.
The Score. Ready-to-retire safecracker Nick, flamboyant fence Max and talented but volatile thief Jackie team up to rob the Montreal Customs House.
The 10 Sins. In this social drama of sin and remorse, a man reels at the discovery that his wife has been unfaithful, and gives her an ultimatum.
Roger Corman's Death Race 2050. In this dystopian sequel, kills equal points in a violently gory annual cross-country road race sponsored by the United Corporations of America.

titulo: Equestria Girls: Tales of Canterlot High
texto: Equestria Girls: Tales of Canterlot High. In an alternate universe Equestria, the ponies have become teenage girls who must learn what it means to be human while attending Canterlot High.
Arisan 2. A group of friends reunites for a vacation amid nature, where they laugh about their shared history and bond over difficult truths.

titulo: Secrets of Her Majesty's Secret Service
texto: Secrets of Her Majesty's Secret Service. This documentary spotlights more than 100 years of operatives and operations in the U.K.'s secret service, the world's oldest intelligence agency.
Ishqiya. A deceitful woman seduces two of her late husband’s crooked friends into helping her hatch a nefarious kidnapping plot for a hefty ransom.
My Suicide. After declaring that he's going to film himself committing suicide for a school project, Archie videotapes reactions from friends and family.
The Mask of Zorro. An aging Zorro passes the torch to a young successor, schooling him in discipline and training him to take up the sword against crooked officials.

titulo: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
texto: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers. Frodo and Sam head to Mordor to destroy the One Ring of Power while Gimli, Legolas and Aragorn search for the orc-captured Merry and Pippin.
Monopoly (The Bank Of Luck). Seeking revenge on his employer, a lazy bank agent and his two dim-witted friends concoct an elaborate but flawed heist.
A StoryBots Christmas. Bo thinks her holiday gift-giving isn't good enough, so she heads north to study under Santa Claus – only to find he's missing.
Iqbal. A boy with a hearing and speech impairment – and extraordinary athletic ability – chases his lifelong dream of playing cricket for India.
Oddbods. Seven furry, colorful friends who live in the small town of Oddsville like to play, have adventures and get into all sorts of creative mischief.
So Much Love to Give. Fernando is a family man — equally committed to each of his two families. But one wrong turn brings them crashing together.
Nuestra Lucha Libre. This documentary series lifts the mask on Mexican wrestling, diving into the daily lives of its stars, examining the sport’s cultural impact and more.
Barbie: Spy Squad. A high-tech spy agency transforms Barbie and her best friends into secret agents, using their gymnastics skills to bring down a cunning cat burglar.
Home Game. This docuseries profiles unique and dangerous traditional sports from around the world, as well as the communities and cultures where they thrive.
Being Mrs Elliot. When a scorned wife from the city shares a cab with a troubled villager, a fiery accident forces them to live out each other's lives.
Trigger Warning with Killer Mike. In this funny and provocative series, rapper and activist Killer Mike puts his revolutionary ideas about achieving social change into action.
Arthur Christmas. At Santa Claus's super-secret toy-making facility, Mr. Claus entrusts his son, Arthur, to carry out an ultra-important Christmas mission.
Monster High: Haunted. Hearing that their old school is being haunted, Spectra Vondergeist and her pals head back to Monster High to get to the bottom of the scary spookery.
Pucca: Love Recipe. Faced with a threat to the survival of her family restaurant, as well as a rival for Garu's heart, Pucca fights for all that she loves.
Thambi. As a tip leads a local politician to his long-estranged son, his daughter has doubts about whether the young man is truly family or just an impostor.
Halt and Catch Fire. Re-creating the dawn of the personal computer era, this digital drama tracks the fates of an industry visionary and his brilliant colleagues.
Donnie Brasco. When FBI agent Joe Pistone goes undercover to infiltrate the mob, he starts to identify with the made men he's charged with taking down.

titulo: Do Paise Ki Dhoop Chaar Aane Ki Baarish
texto: Do Paise Ki Dhoop Chaar Aane Ki Baarish. When a sex worker hires a gay songwriter to care for her disabled son, the ensuing bonds that form offer a complex portrayal of love and family.
The Space Between Us. After years of limited contact with Earth, an inquisitive teen who lives on Mars makes an interplanetary trek to discover his own origins.
Wasp Network. Based on a true and gripping story: Cuban spies infiltrate exile groups in the 1990s to stop terrorism against the island, but at a high personal cost.
Secrets of Chatsworth. Tales of tragedy and scandal unfold through the history of Chatsworth, a grand estate that has been home to some of England's most noted aristocrats.
The Pirate Fairy. In this spritely tale, Tinker Bell and her friends set out to find free-spirited fairy Zarina after she makes off with some precious Blue Pixie Dust.
Ip Man 2. New in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man perseveres and retaliates against his rivals' opposition to the Wing Chun fighting style he teaches.
Giri / Haji. Family duty sends a lawman to London to look for his mob-assassin brother as a yakuza war threatens to engulf Tokyo. Trust is even tougher to find.
The 43. This docuseries disputes the Mexican government's account of how and why 43 students from Ayotzinapa Rural Teachers' College vanished in Iguala in 2014.
Samantaral. On a family visit, a young man and his girlfriend set out to discover why his eccentric uncle has been mysteriously confined to one room for years.
Hello, Me!. Miserable and unsuccessful, a woman thinks she's lost all her spark — until one day, her spunky younger self appears in front of her demanding change.
Bawarchi. A dysfunctional middle-class family is transformed by the attentions of their talented new chef – until he vanishes along with their valuable jewels.

titulo: El patrón, radiografía de un crimen
texto: El patrón, radiografía de un crimen. A lawyer defends an illiterate man whose exploitation by a cruel boss while working as a butcher in Buenos Aires led to tragedy. Based on a true case.

titulo: Struggle: The Life and Lost Art of Szukalski
texto: Struggle: The Life and Lost Art of Szukalski. Artists in LA discover the work of forgotten Polish sculptor Stanislav Szukalski, a mad genius whose true story unfolds chapter by astounding chapter.
Club Friday The Series 8. The eighth installment of this popular Thai series, based on a real-life call-in radio show, dramatizes personal stories of romance and heartbreak.
Singles Villa. In a luxurious condominium complex with draconian rules forbidding all romance, two residents fall in love and dare to start a secret relationship.
Tayee. An Egyptian doctor becomes a police informant and uses his rare gift of tracking ancient artifacts in the smuggling business.
Bring It On: Worldwide Showdown. When cheerleading champs the Rebels are challenged by an edgy new squad, they take on teams from all over the world in a virtual cheer battle.
Tall Girl. After years of slouching through life, 6-foot-1 teen Jodi resolves to conquer her insecurities and gets caught up in a high school love triangle.
Phir Hera Pheri. Driven by greed, three rich friends seek to double their wealth and find themselves indebted to a ruthless gangster.
Love Cuisine. A successful Taiwanese chef moves home from Europe to teach at a cooking school. He soon clashes with a pretty teacher he met under odd circumstances.
Saavat. In rural India, a detective's investigation of seven confounding suicides uncovers revelations about the myths and mindsets of the rest of the village.
Biking Borders. Best friends Max and Nono bike from Berlin to Beijing, collecting donations to build a school for a unique fundraising adventure in this documentary.

titulo: Blood Brothers: Malcolm X & Muhammad Ali
texto: Blood Brothers: Malcolm X & Muhammad Ali. From a chance meeting to a tragic fallout, Malcolm X and Muhammad Ali's extraordinary bond cracks under the weight of distrust and shifting ideals.
You Are My Home. After becoming separated from her family, a young girl finds herself in the care of a heartbroken woman who faces her own struggles.
The Crown. This drama follows the political rivalries and romance of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped the second half of the 20th century.
Don't Look Down. Aided by dramatic reconstructions and archive footage, Sir Richard Branson recounts his daring attempts to break hot air balloon records.

titulo: Stars in the Sky: A Hunting Story
texto: Stars in the Sky: A Hunting Story. This documentary follows a group of hunters as they grapple with the complexities, controversies, and contradictions of pursuing animals in the wild.
NOVA: Eclipse Over America. Scientists reveal how the 2017 solar eclipse provided new clues into how the sun works, from its scorching atmosphere to its deadly solar storms.
Bride For Rent. Rocco needs to hire a bride so he can access his trust fund. Rocky desperately needs a job. Their marriage starts out fake, but ends up as much more.
The Art of War. Framed for the murder of an ambassador, a former member of the United Nations' elite covert action unit will do whatever it takes to clear his name.
13 Reasons Why: Beyond the Reasons. Cast members, writers, producers and mental health professionals discuss some of the difficult issues and themes explored in "13 Reasons Why."
Poseidon. A tidal wave spells disaster for a ship of New Year's Eve revelers when it capsizes the mammoth vessel, sending passengers into a battle for survival.
Sweet Virginia. In a remote Alaskan town reeling from a sudden triple murder, a former rodeo champ befriends a lone newcomer with a violent occupation.
My Step Dad: The Hippie. When three adult siblings meet the offbeat man who their widowed mom fawns over, they take drastic actions to stop them from ever getting married.
Milada. Politician and human rights campaigner Milada Horáková battles against all odds to defend her beliefs in a Czechoslovakia under Communist rule.
Si Doel the Movie 2. As Sarah and her child look to settle in Jakarta, Zaenab searches for answers and gets caught between defending her marriage to Doel or letting it go.
The Rehearsal. A drama student is torn between creative possibility and ethical boundaries when his girlfriend's family gets caught up in a sex scandal.
College Romance. Three best friends look for love, laughs and some lifelong memories while attending college together.
Midnight Sun. Born with a fatal sensitivity to sunlight, a sheltered teen girl falls for her neighbor, but hides her condition from him as their romance blossoms.
Middleditch & Schwartz. Comedy duo Thomas Middleditch and Ben Schwartz turn small ideas into epically funny stories in this series of completely improvised comedy specials.
Seven. After his affluent father passes, a man must survive seven days in the Nigerian neighborhood of Ajegunle, where obstacles keep him from his inheritance.
Million Yen Women. Five beautiful but mysterious women move in with unsuccessful novelist Shin, who manages their odd household in exchange for a tidy monthly sum.
The Intent 2: The Come Up. During a trip to Jamaica, a London gang targets a disloyal member who has been meeting with rivals. Meanwhile, an undercover cop stands among them.
Bon Cop, Bad Cop. An English-speaking officer from Toronto and a French-speaking cop from Montreal are forced to work together to solve a crime.
Kiss Me First. A lonely young woman hooked on a virtual reality game befriends a party girl who leads her into a world of new thrills and dark secrets.

titulo: The Misadventures of Hedi and Cokeman
texto: The Misadventures of Hedi and Cokeman. In Paris, two dysfunctional dealers use family ties to try to boost their small drug business in this crass comedy based on the webseries.
Albion: The Enchanted Stallion. After a magical horse transports her to a fantasy world ruled by an evil general, a brave girl sets out to save the land once and for all.
The Innocent. An accidental killing leads a man down a dark hole of intrigue and murder. Just as he finds love and freedom, one phone call brings back the nightmare.
Hibana: Spark. A dramatic series about friendship and conflict between two comedians who search for meaning in life and comedy. Based on the prize-winning book.
Malcolm & Marie. As a filmmaker and his girlfriend return home from his movie premiere, smoldering tensions and painful revelations push them toward a romantic reckoning.
Legal Hash. After a failed heist leads to a stint behind bars, a group of men reenters society with a risky business plan that soon reveals their true colors.
The Legacy of the Bones. A year after solving a series of murders, detective Amaia is faced with a related mystery in the Baztán Valley that ends up hitting very close to home.
Gigi. Gigi's an avant-garde French waif being groomed as the fille de joie of affluent and handsome Gaston. Soon Gigi metamorphoses into a stunning beauty.

titulo: The Only Mother To You All
texto: The Only Mother To You All. Raising her large family alone after her husband's death, Ina searches for work and finally lands the most unlikely job: president of the Philippines.
Wadjda. A persistent 10-year-old wishes for a new bicycle so she can beat her friend (a boy) in a race. But it's going to take some ingenuity to get one.
The Haunted Hathaways. Single mom Michelle Hathaway and her daughters find that they share their New Orleans home with the ghosts of single dad Ray Preston and his two sons.
Headspace Guide to Meditation. Headspace takes a friendly, animated look at the benefits of meditation while offering techniques and guided meditations to jump-start your practice.
Tamanchey. A man and a woman on the run from the law are drawn to each other through the common bond of their mutual dependency.
Intersection. Two wealthy businessmen with car obsessions cross paths with an idealist pediatrician. Love enters the equation, and their lives change for good.
Coffee & Kareem. An inept Detroit cop must team up with his girlfriend's foul-mouthed young son when their first crack at bonding time uncovers a criminal conspiracy.

titulo: The 101-Year-Old Man Who Skipped Out on the Bill and Disappeared
texto: The 101-Year-Old Man Who Skipped Out on the Bill and Disappeared. In need of money, an eccentric ex-spy and his younger octogenarian partner embark on an international quest for a valuable Soviet soda formula.
Shimmer Lake. Unfolding in reverse time, this darkly comic crime thriller follows a local sheriff hunting three bank robbery suspects, one of whom is his brother.
From Japan to Egypt. After his wife relocates to her home country of Japan, an Egyptian man – and father of two rambunctious kids – tries to win her back.
Born Racer. In this all-access pass, IndyCar champion Scott Dixon and his team navigate the risks on the road in the quest to win it all.
Raja Hindustani. When a poor taxi driver falls in love with a wealthy young woman, he must stand up to her family and contend with his own insecurities.
Kapoor & Sons. Returning home to visit their ill grandfather, two estranged brothers must confront their unresolved rivalry while their parents’ marriage frays.
Coven of Sisters. Basque Country, 1609. To postpone their execution, a group of women accused of witchcraft lure their inquisitor into witnessing the witches' Sabbath.
Homeland. Determined to trace her ancestral history, an Armenian woman travels to a French village, where she befriends a kind man and, better yet, finds herself.
A Trip to Jamaica. A newly engaged couple's romantic vacation in Jamaica turns into a mischievous adventure that tests their union in wild and unexpected ways.
GIMS: On the Record. Go backstage with beloved rap superstar Gims in the year leading up to his major 2019 Stade de France performance in this up-close documentary.
Chhota Bheem Aur Hanuman. When two evil entities kidnap a princess in a plot to build a new kingdom, Bheem takes them on with the help of the courageous monkey god Hanuman.
Shtisel. A Haredi family living in an ultra-Orthodox neighborhood of Jerusalem reckons with love, loss and the doldrums of daily life.
Company of Heroes. During the last major German offensive of World War II, a group of Allied soldiers sets out against all odds to turn the war around.
Deadly Sins. A multimillionaire fakes his death and forces his relatives to live together in his mansion for one year to see who's worthy of inheriting his fortune.
The Princess Switch: Switched Again. When Margaret's Christmas coronation complicates her love life, her double Stacy steps in to save the day. But will a third look-alike ruin their plan?

titulo: A Go! Go! Cory Carson Summer Camp
texto: A Go! Go! Cory Carson Summer Camp. Cory's spending the summer at Camp Friendship with his best friend, Freddie. But jealousy flares when Freddie brings his cousin Rosie along for the ride.
Barbie Life in the Dreamhouse. Join blond icon Barbie and her fabulous friends as their behind-the-scenes adventures are revealed in this animated Web series.
Murphy's Law of Love. An online matchmaker who's convinced she's living under a curse finds her theories on life and love tested when she meets a shrewd divorce expert.
Major Grom: Plague Doctor. When a masked vigilante’s killing spree throws a city into chaos, a renegade detective and his rookie partner are the only ones who can stop it.
Jessica Darling's It List. Armed with popularity tips from her beautiful older sister, precocious Jessica Darling prepares to navigate the treacherous world of seventh grade.
My Country: The New Age. At the end of the Goryeo period, there were those who led the charge to proclaim a new age – and the ordinary individuals who risked everything.
GANTZ:O. Teams of recently deceased people who've been revived and given high-tech weapons must cooperate to defeat an army of monsters in Tokyo and Osaka.
Diablero. When a young girl goes missing in a big city, a desperate priest joins a demon hunter and his motley crew on an otherworldly mission to find her.
AK vs AK. After a public spat with a movie star, a disgraced director retaliates by kidnapping the actor’s daughter, filming the search for her in real time.
Elena. In this documentary, the director remembers a sister who left behind her life under Brazil’s dictatorship and moved to New York with dreams of acting.
Pyaar Ka Punchnama. Matters of the heart introduce chaos into the once-idyllic bachelor existence of three young men who share an apartment.
Greenhouse Academy. When teen siblings Hayley and Alex enter an elite boarding school, they find rivalry, romance and a mystery related to the recent loss of their mom.
The Meyerowitz Stories (New and Selected). Grudges and rivalries abound as three adult siblings converge in New York to contend with their prickly artist father – and his fading legacy.
The Bridge. A Yoruba prince and a young lady from a prominent Igbo family face tribal prejudice and parental pressure when they secretly wed.
Westside Story. Spirited high school misfits with hearts of gold begin their journeys into adulthood as they navigate school, friendship, romance and heartbreak.
Gurgaon. When the daughter of a wealthy family returns from college, she gets a frosty welcome from her brother, who has problems – and plans – of his own.
Inheritors. After a chance encounter in LA, two teens from different social backgrounds reunite at an exclusive high school attended by Korea’s über rich.
Michael Lost and Found. Benjie Nycum travels to Wyoming to visit his ex-lover, Michael Glatze, a former gay activist who now lives with his wife and works as a church pastor.
The Land of the Enlightened. In the rugged mountains of Afghanistan, armed bands of young boys survive by scavenging for old land mines, mining lapis lazuli and trading in opium.
Crazy Ex-Girlfriend. Still pining for Josh, the boy who dumped her ages ago, whip-smart lawyer Rebecca jettisons her New York life and moves to California to win him back.
Jonas. During Carnival, two teens from different classes meet years after being kept apart. Bad decisions lead the boy to hide with the girl inside a float.
Òlòtūré. In Lagos, a journalist goes undercover as a prostitute to expose human trafficking. What she finds is a world of exploited women and ruthless violence.
My Friend Pinto. A bright-eyed villager comes face-to-face with the gritty realities of modern-day Mumbai when he sets out to find his childhood friend.
John Carter. One minute, Civil War veteran John Carter is evading Apaches; the next, he's waking up on Mars, a once-fruitful planet that's devolved into chaos.
The Amazing Praybeyt Benjamin. Now a celebrity, Benjie is tasked with taking care of a General's young son, who has information about a looming terrorist threat.

titulo: Listen Up! The Lives of Quincy Jones
texto: Listen Up! The Lives of Quincy Jones. Steering clear of convention, this affecting documentary pays tribute to the life and work of composer, musician and producer Quincy Jones, one of the best-known and most respected men in the music industry.
Dean. As his father takes steps to move on, a New Yorker grieving his mom's death visits Los Angeles where new possibilities may bring him out of his funk.
Kid-E-Cats. Cookie, Pudding and Candy are kitten siblings whose favorite things are sweet treats and letting their curiosity lead them on adventures in learning.
DreamWorks Holiday Classics. Join your DreamWorks friends for these four holiday specials, featuring Shrek and Donkey, Hiccup and Toothless, and the wacky animals from Madagascar.
Sometimes. Seven strangers anxiously waiting for their HIV test results decide to bribe the clinic receptionist to get them early, learning one is positive.
She's the One. When his best friend gets stranded in the rain and becomes the subject of a romantic viral video, a morning show host must confront his true feelings.
Saving Zoë. A reserved high school freshman acts out when she recovers a diary that offers clues to a secret world that could be behind her sister's murder.
Prague. The chaotic ramblings of a young architect's mind take hold of his life as he leaves behind his past in India to work in Prague.
Vettai. This powerful Tamil action film follows the shared fate of two very different siblings: policeman Thiru and his roguish brother, Guru.
End Game. Facing an inevitable outcome, terminally ill patients meet extraordinary medical practitioners seeking to change our approach to life and death.
Enter the Anime. What is anime? Through deep-dives with notable masterminds of this electrifying genre, this fast-paced peek behind the curtain seeks to find the answers.
Cold Feet. At a resort getaway, the fate of two couples collides when a wife unexpectedly runs into an old flame as he hesitates to propose to his girlfriend.
The Bad Batch. Banished to a wasteland of undesirables, a young woman struggles to find her feet among a drug-soaked desert society and an enclave of cannibals.
Bobby Sands: 66 Days. In 1981, an imprisoned Irish Republican Army soldier went on a hunger strike that galvanized his movement and made him a controversial global icon.
Perfume. When a singer is found murdered, with her scent glands excised from her body, detectives probe a group of friends who attended boarding school with her.
#cats_the_mewvie. This pawesome documentary explores how our feline friends became online icons, from the earliest text memes to the rise of celebrity cat influencers.

titulo: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
texto: Zack and Miri Make a Porno. Zack and Miri make and star in an adult film to bring in easy money. But their unspoken feelings for each other might threaten the whole enterprise.
True: Wuzzle Wegg Day. Spring has sprung in Rainbow City, and Wuzzle Wegg Day is right around the corner! But Bartleby's convinced that a Wegg-stealing monster is on the loose.
Workin' Moms. Maternity leave is over and it's time for these four moms to return to work while navigating kids, bosses, love and life in modern-day Toronto.
Dancing Angels. A group of aspiring young musicians yearn for stardom while navigating the ups and downs of friendship, romance, and life at school.

titulo: ReMastered: The Two Killings of Sam Cooke
texto: ReMastered: The Two Killings of Sam Cooke. While Sam Cooke rose to stardom as a soul singer, his outspoken views on civil rights drew attention that may have contributed to his death at age 33.
MINDHUNTER. In the late 1970s two FBI agents expand criminal science by delving into the psychology of murder and getting uneasily close to all-too-real monsters.
Everybody Knows. Journeying back to her small Spanish hometown for her sister's wedding, Laura must grapple with long-buried secrets when her daughter is abducted.
Under the Eiffel Tower. An American man in the midst of a mid-life crisis travels to the French countryside to find a new lease on life.
Fred Claus. The holiday season is ruined for Santa Claus when his cranky older brother – a repo man with a sizable rap sheet – visits him at the North Pole.
State of Play. A veteran journalist teams up with a young reporter to untangle a web of lies surrounding the suspicious death of a woman tied to a powerful politician.
Chhota Bheem: Bheem vs Aliens. Space invaders have kidnapped Dholakpur’s king and princess! The only way Bheem can rescue them? Defeat the aliens in a cricket match.
​Goli Soda 2. A taxi driver, a gangster and an athlete struggle to better their lives despite obstacles like crooked politicians, evil dons and caste barriers.

titulo: Age of Samurai: Battle for Japan
texto: Age of Samurai: Battle for Japan. Dynamic reenactments and expert commentaries bring to life the tumultuous history and power struggles of a warring 16th-century feudal Japan.
La Última Fiesta. Three best buddies are thrown into a wild chase for a priceless painting that was stolen from a house they used to throw a huge party.
Rising High. Ready to do anything to get rich, a young man upends the Berlin property market with his shady pal, till the good times threaten to destroy it all.
Mystery Men. A team of far-from-super heroes try to earn respect by springing into action when brave and dashing Captain Amazing disappears.
The Twilight Saga: Eclipse. With a bloodthirsty enemy on a quest for revenge, Bella must reconcile her love for vampire Edward and her growing feelings for werewolf Jacob.
Between Maybes. A former actress takes a trip to Japan, where she meets a young man who provides an escape from reality and makes her consider a different way of life.
Manson Family Vacation. The pleasant family life of an L.A. attorney is disrupted by the sudden arrival of his brother, who is obsessed with the Charles Manson murders.
Sand Castle. After the invasion of Iraq in 2003, a reluctant soldier's platoon is dispatched on a dangerous mission to repair a hostile village's water system.
Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles. When Mick "Crocodile" Dundee and his family land in Los Angeles, they soon learn some lessons about American life in this comedy sequel.
On the Real. A group of reality stars transitions into their newly achieved fame while dealing with the demands of an obnoxious TV executive and their regular lives.
Somewhere Between. A local news producer is given one chance to relive a deadly week and stop a serial killer. If she fails, she'll lose her daughter forever.
Trio and a Bed. After graduation, three women from distinct backgrounds find themselves in the real world, facing the challenges of work, romance and unexpected fame.
Stargate SG-1. Stargate Command roars into action when Jack O'Neill and his crew find a Stargates map that lets them combat alien maneuvers all across the galaxy.
Brick Mansions. An undercover police detective partners with an ex-convict to take down a drug kingpin amid grime and crime in a walled-off Detroit housing project.
Show Me the Money. Four ordinary family members find their lives turned upside down when they become overnight millionaires thanks to an unlikely benefactor.
Humsafar. To fulfill her mother's dying wish, middle-class Khirad marries elite Ashar. But those who disapprove plot to turn Ashar against his wife.
Panoptic. This documentary dissects Lebanon's present-day paradoxes stemming from years of conflict as the director attempts to reconcile with her nation's past.
Resurface. A suicidal war veteran finds like-minded souls in a surf therapy program that helps traumatized soldiers heal while riding the waves.
Road to Yesterday. Their marriage failing, Victoria and Izu try to reconnect during a road trip. But bringing long-repressed secrets to light threatens yet more discord.
World Famous Lover. When his frustrated girlfriend decides to leave him, a struggling writer gets down to work on stories of romance he hopes will win her back.
Mrs. Serial Killer. When a doctor gets jailed for a string of shocking murders, his loyal wife sets out to commit a copycat crime to prove his innocence.
#Selfie 69. After a painful breakup, a trio of party-loving friends makes a bet: who can get married in three days.
The Car: Road to Revenge. Trying to uphold justice in a lawless future, a D.A. is slain by cyberpunks but a supernatural twist sends his car on a bloody quest for revenge.
Private Life. Struggling to conceive, a couple in their 40s are almost out of options – until a sliver of hope arrives in the form of their visiting step-niece.
Act of Valor. An elite squad of Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA agent from a lethal terrorist cell.
Secrets of the Saqqara Tomb. After unearthing a tomb that had been untouched for 4,400 years, Egyptian archaeologists attempt to decipher the history of the extraordinary find.
Brain Games. This interactive series uses games, illusions and experiments to illustrate how our brains manufacture our reality and often play tricks on us.
Diamond City. A prominent prosecuting attorney must defend her innocence — and her life — when she's set up and sent to prison as she investigates a conspiracy.
The Devil and Father Amorth. In Rome, "Exorcist" director William Friedkin follows a 91-year-old priest who performs a real demonic exorcism on a woman from a small Italian town.
Loving. A young couple's interracial marriage in 1958 sparks a case that leads to the Supreme Court. Based on the true story of Richard and Mildred Loving.
The Bad Education Movie. Britain's most ineffective but caring teacher takes his class to Cornwall for one last school trip, where anything could happen – and probably will.
Splash and Bubbles. Curious pals Splash, Bubbles, Dunk and Ripple have fun exploring new places, making new friends and learning all about their amazing ocean home.
The Impossible. Tracking one family's harrowing experiences, this gripping drama depicts the chaos generated by the massive 2004 tsunami in Southeast Asia.
About Time. When Tim learns that the men in his family can travel in time and change their own lives, he decides to go back and win the woman of his dreams.
Hinterland. Forsaking London for the rustic landscapes of Wales, a police detective with a troubled soul finds himself in a place with secrets as dark as his own.
Black Panther. T'Challa, the superpowered new leader of the hidden, highly advanced African nation of Wakanda, strives to protect his home from enemies old and new.
Man Up. A single woman seizes an opportunity when, while standing under a train station clock, she meets a stranger who mistakes her for his blind date.
Monster High: Great Scarrier Reef. At a Monster High party, Lagoona and pals are sucked into the reef, where she'll have to come to terms with her flaws and confront an old frenemy.
China Salesman. A Chinese engineer travels to a war-torn African country to rebuild its telecommunications but instead finds massive corruption and explosive danger.
Designated Survivor: 60 Days. When the National Assembly suffers a catastrophic attack, Minister of Environment Park Mu-jin must find a way to lead Korea through the ensuing chaos.
The Short Game. They are fiercely competitive athletes, determined to become champions on one of the world's toughest golf courses. And they're still in grade school.
Battle Creek. A polished FBI agent must team up with a cynical cop when he's dispatched to Battle Creek, Michigan, to set up an office at the local precinct.
Holy Man 2. Former rap musician Joey Boy is now a monk who takes Father Teng's place at his rural temple, where a crisis develops involving a nearby stone quarry.
The Kissing Booth 2. With college decisions looming, Elle juggles her long-distance romance with Noah, changing relationship with bestie Lee and feelings for a new classmate.
The Feels. During their bachelorette weekend, a lesbian couple's relationship hits a snag when one of the brides confesses to never having an orgasm.
Keeping the Bees. Ayşe returns from Germany to her Black Sea hometown and sets out to fulfill her mom's dying wish — to care for her beloved bee farms.
Soldier. On the run from Indian police, a mysterious man escapes to Australia and falls in love with the daughter of an Indian criminal who lives there.
My Brother ... Nikhil. After being diagnosed HIV-positive, a champion swimmer is disowned and harassed by all except his loving sister and loyal boyfriend.
Kuppivala. A young woman talented at traditional dance finds her life changed when her love for a man clashes with the wishes of her father.
Tallulah. While searching for her ex-boyfriend, a young drifter impulsively kidnaps a baby from a neglectful mother and pretends the child is her own.
Pulp Fiction. This stylized crime caper weaves together stories featuring a burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner and a washed-up boxer.

titulo: Ariana grande: excuse me, i love you
texto: Ariana grande: excuse me, i love you. Ariana Grande takes the stage in London for her Sweetener World Tour and shares a behind-the-scenes look at her life in rehearsal and on the road.
Home Again. A newly single mom takes in three young male filmmakers as boarders, but her estranged husband returns to complicate her new, unconventional life.
Jacob's Ladder. After being reunited with a brother he thought was killed in combat, a former army medic begins to experience violent, paranoid visions.
Shiny_Flakes: The Teenage Drug Lord. Max S. reveals how he built a drug empire from his childhood bedroom in this story that inspired the series "How to Sell Drugs Online (Fast)."
Gatao 2: Rise of the King. When a zealous gang leader plans to take out a friend-turned-rival for control of his turf, internal tensions complicate the battle to be the boss.
Potato Potahto. A divorced couple decides to continue sharing a home but their already-delicate cohabiting scheme unravels when they begin dating other people.
The Grandmaster. As the Japanese invasion looms, Chinese kung fu master Ip Man's world changes when rival master Gong Er and her father arrive in his village.
And Then Came Lola. In this lesbian-themed nod to the film Run Lola Run, a photographer races against the clock to make it to an important meeting on time.
Krishna and His Leela. Torn between his past and present girlfriends, a confused bachelor’s indecisiveness spins a web of lies and cheating as he struggles to commit.
Khosla Ka Ghosla. A cranky control freak must rely on his comically dysfunctional family to pull off a scam on a greedy land shark who's stolen his prized property.
Ocean's Eleven. Frank Sinatra leads an all-star cast as Danny Ocean, who decides to knock over a few casinos on the Las Vegas Strip with his buddies.
Birders. Bird watchers on both sides of the U.S.-Mexico border share their enthusiasm for protecting and preserving some of the world's most beautiful species.
Good Time. After spearheading an ill-fated bank robbery, a man must get his mentally challenged younger brother out of jail while eluding his own capture.
Sofia the First. When her commoner mother marries the king, average-girl Sofia finds that being a real princess isn't all it's cracked up to be.
StartUp. An attempt to launder stolen money finances a cryptocurrency that puts entrepreneurs in business with a corrupt FBI agent and a Miami gang.
Full Out. After a debilitating accident ends her Olympic dreams, gymnast Ariana Berlin finds recovery and hope in the world of hip-hop and college athletics.
Ali & Ratu Ratu Queens. After his father's passing, a teenager sets out for New York in search of his estranged mother and soon finds love and connection in unexpected places.
Antariksha Ke Rakhwale. Space villains have abducted all the superheroes! It’s up to Bheem and his trusty team to save the others.
The Young Vagabond. To avenge his master, a wine-loving young man steps up his fighting skills to defeat a powerful thief in a life-or-death match.
The Climb. A young Senegalese-French man from humble roots sets out to climb Mount Everest to impress the woman he loves – and slowly becomes a media sensation.
Tiger. Imprisoned for drug smuggling as a child, a young man uses the law he studied while in jail to take revenge on those who wronged him.
The President's Barber. The personal barber to the president, as well as his wife and only son, get tangled in the political chaos that gripped South Korea in the late 1900s.
