Shrek the Musical. The greatest fairy tale never told comes to life in this colorful, song-filled, Tony Award-winning Broadway production based on the hit movie.
Veerappan. A police official assembles an elaborate network of spies and undercover operatives to bring down a ruthless bandit with a private army.
The Could’ve-Gone-All-the-Way Committee. People bring their stories of missed lust connections to an objective panel of experts who then judge whether they could have gone all the way or not.
Sadma. After a traumatic injury leaves her with amnesia and age regression, a young woman is sold to a brothel before a teacher becomes her savior.
Blue Miracle. To save their cash-strapped orphanage, a guardian and his kids partner with a washed-up boat captain for a chance to win a lucrative fishing competition.
The Outsiders. A trio of delinquent brothers fends off neighborhood rivals until one joins a gang to gain protection for the upper-class girl he loves.
Myths & Monsters. This documentary series takes us to the mythic landscapes of Europe to explore some of most enduring legends produced by European culture.
Amar. Young Laura and Carlos experience the intensity and fragility of first love, as life realities gradually tarnish their idealized notions of romance.

titulo: Seven Souls in the Skull Castle: Season Moon Jogen
texto: Seven Souls in the Skull Castle: Season Moon Jogen. Japan, 1590. Wandering samurai band together to take on the lord of Skull Castle in the “Moon Jogen” version of the show, performed in a 360º theater.
A Plastic Ocean. When he discovers the world's oceans brimming with plastic waste, a documentary filmmaker investigates the pollution's environmental impacts.
The Mind of a Chef. Producer and narrator Anthony Bourdain explores the creative processes of international celebrity chefs to learn what fuels their culinary artistry.
Trash. Three poor Brazilian teens find something suspicious in a garbage heap, then end up on the run from the law as they try to set things right.
Dragons: Rescue Riders. Twins Dak and Leyla and their dragon friends devote their lives to rescuing others, defending their home of Huttsgalor and having fun along the way.
The Family Court. Five lawyers from different firms develop a strong bond of friendship that is occasionally tested by their court cases and growing romantic feelings.
Dirty John. Businesswoman Debra Newell's life unravels when she falls for the lies and manipulation of con man John Meehan. Based on the true-crime podcast.
Out of Life. Kidnapped by guerrillas in Beirut, a French photojournalist refuses to yield his dignity despite being tortured and brainwashed by his captors.
Alias Grace. In 19th-century Canada, a psychiatrist weighs whether a murderess should be pardoned due to insanity. Based on Margaret Atwood's award-winning novel.
Origins Collection. This documentary series explores the stories behind history's most fascinating innovations, including games, technology, sports, medicine and more.
Léa & I. Best friends Léa and Camille explore the notion of healing while traveling to Latin America in search of a cure for a terminal disease.
Power Rangers Turbo. The Rangers use high-tech battle cars to take on Queen Divatox and her Divazords, who mount an attack on the Rangers' beloved Angel Grove.
Shikara. A couple must strive to remain resilient after regional hostilities drive them from their beloved home into a refugee camp.
Reboot: The Guardian Code. Four tech-savvy teens hone their skills as cyber-superheroes in a series of secret missions to save the world.
Black Mirror. This sci-fi anthology series explores a twisted, high-tech near-future where humanity's greatest innovations and darkest instincts collide.
Trophy. This documentary explores the tensions between the lucrative big-game hunting business and wildlife conservation from a variety of perspectives.
Cathedral of the Sea. In 14th-century Barcelona, a serf's determined climb to wealth and freedom incurs the disdain of the noble class and the suspicion of the Inquisition.
Camelia la Texana. Inspired by the famous song "Contrabando y Traición," Camelia, a beautiful girl from San Antonio, kills her lover and becomes a legendary drug runner.

titulo: The Boys in the Band: Something Personal
texto: The Boys in the Band: Something Personal. Decades after his play first put gay life center stage, Mart Crowley joins the cast and crew of the 2020 film to reflect on the story's enduring legacy.
Free to Play. This documentary follows three professional video game players as they compete in an international tournament with a million-dollar prize.
Once a Gangster. Two former triads are tapped to run in an election for leader of the underworld, but both want normal lives. Each must outwit the other to lose.

titulo: Winter on Fire: Ukraine's Fight for Freedom
texto: Winter on Fire: Ukraine's Fight for Freedom. Over 93 days in Ukraine, what started as peaceful student demonstrations became a violent revolution and full-fledged civil rights movement.
¡Ay, mi madre!. When her estranged mother suddenly dies, a woman must follow the quirky instructions laid out in the will in order to collect an important inheritance.
Tobot. They’re robots that can transform into cars – and the Tobots are committed to fighting villains to protect the city and root out crime.

titulo: The Spooky Tale of Captain Underpants Hack-a-ween
texto: The Spooky Tale of Captain Underpants Hack-a-ween. When Melvin tries to cancel Halloween, clever best friends Harold and George create their own spooky holiday – and it's a huge success!
Kill Command. On a remote island, elite soldiers discover their training exercise is actually an experimental death trap teeming with efficiently lethal robots.
Pandora. When an earthquake hits a Korean village housing a run-down nuclear power plant, a man risks his life to save the country from imminent disaster.
High Score. This docuseries traces the history of classic video games, featuring insights from the innovators who brought these worlds and characters to life.
SDU: Sex Duties Unit. Four man-children in an elite tactical unit gallivant around Macau for a weekend of debauchery that gets them in trouble with the law.
Enemigo íntimo. Siblings separated as children who no longer recognize each other are pitted against each other in a war involving drugs, crime and betrayal.
Silver Skates. On the frozen rivers and canals of St. Petersburg, a petty thief on skates warms the heart of an aristocrat’s daughter as forces try to keep them apart.
Mumbai Cha Raja. This coming-of-age tale follows Rahul, a young boy growing up in a Mumbai slum whose alcoholic father abuses him and his mother.
Luccas Neto in: Children's Day. When Luccas Neto plans a big Children's Day celebration, an unexpected threat at school puts the party – and his friends – at risk.
History's Greatest Hoaxes. Using previously unseen footage, this documentary series offers new insights into some of the biggest scams and forgeries in human history.
Lommbock. After finding love in drug-free Dubai, Stefan returns to Germany to grab documents for his wedding. But old buddy Kai's bad habits complicate things.
Snowden. This thriller traces Edward Snowden's journey from Army recruit to disillusioned government analyst bent on exposing vast U.S. surveillance programs.
Dare to Be Wild. Irish landscape designer Mary Reynolds fights to bring her wild and unconventional style to the esteemed Chelsea Flower Show.

titulo: Loo Loo Kids: Johny & Friends Musical Adventures
texto: Loo Loo Kids: Johny & Friends Musical Adventures. Music-loving baby Johny goes on dance-filled adventures with his family, friends and adorable critters in this colorful, animated preschooler series.
Power Rangers Dino Charge. In the time of dinosaurs, the ancient and powerful Energems were lost on Earth, and now the evil bounty hunter Sledge has returned to find them.

titulo: Tini: The New Life of Violetta
texto: Tini: The New Life of Violetta. After completing a world tour, a teen pop star spends the summer at an Italian villa to recover from heartbreak and grow into a mature artist.

titulo: Walt Disney Animation Studios Short Films Collection
texto: Walt Disney Animation Studios Short Films Collection. This collection of 12 short films from Disney includes "Frozen Fever," the Mickey Mouse short "Get a Horse!" and Oscar winners "Paperman" and "Feast."
Luv Kushh. Based on the last book of the epic Ramayana, this series follows the endeavors and adventures of Lord Rama’s twin sons through their childhood.
The Place Beyond the Pines. A violent confrontation between a motorcycle-riding bank robber and a rookie cop spirals into a tense generational feud.
Squid Game. Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.
Imperfect. After a brawl lands him in a Boys’ Home, a teen seems to be on a promising path until loyalty to his gangster buddy leads to even bigger trouble.
Aliens Ate My Homework. Tiny alien lawmen fly into Rod's bedroom and recruit him into helping them stop an intergalactic criminal – who's disguised as a very familiar human.

titulo: The Mitfords: A Tale of Two Sisters
texto: The Mitfords: A Tale of Two Sisters. Jessica and Diana were sisters who were separated by just a few years in age. But their political ideologies couldn't have been any farther apart.
The Command. For the crew trapped aboard a sunken Russian submarine the deadliest threat is the bureaucracy on land. Based on a true story.
Be with Me. They were the boy band to beat until fame tore them apart. Ten years later, five friends and an ex-love reunite and find themselves closer than ever.
Dear Affy. An engaged couple hit a number of speed bumps on their road to matrimony including major career complications and questions of fidelity.
Catfight. Two college frenemies whose lives aren't what they hoped meet up decades later and escalate their resentments from verbal jabs to bloody brawls.
Kambili: The Whole 30 Yards. Determined to marry before she turns 30, a woman tries to change her impulsive ways and do whatever it takes to win back the boyfriend who left her.
Cobra Kai. Decades after the tournament that changed their lives, the rivalry between Johnny and Daniel reignites in this sequel to the "Karate Kid" films.
Devrai. After science student Shesh Shahi – a shy eccentric with a strange connection to nature – is examined by a team of mental hospital doctors, a gripping portrait of schizophrenia emerges.
Tucker and Dale vs. Evil. Expecting to relax at their "vacation" cabin, two backwoods boys see their trip turn into a nightmare when they're accused of being psychotic killers.
El límite infinito. From early struggles to his climb up the Himalayas, Jean Maggi gets profiled in this documentary that highlights his advancement of adaptive sports.
Portlandia. Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein send up the residents of Portland, Ore. Typical targets include artisanal light bulbs and feminist bookstores.
NSU German History X. After German reunification, the neo-Nazi National Socialist Underground begins a killing spree while cops fight an uphill battle to catch them.

titulo: The House of Flowers: The Movie
texto: The House of Flowers: The Movie. The De La Mora siblings concoct a mischievous plan to break into their old family home to retrieve a hidden treasure of significant importance.

titulo: Green White Green (And All the Beautiful Colours in My Mosaic of Madness)
texto: Green White Green (And All the Beautiful Colours in My Mosaic of Madness). Three young Nigerian bohemians, each from one of the country's major ethnic groups, explore the directions in which their lives could go.
Wrong No.. Two identical strangers pursue their respective dreams after exchanging lives and getting out from under the thumb of their controlling loved ones.
Martyrs of Marriage. This documentary reveals the cracks in India's anti-dowry act and gives voice to both women and men who've been victimized by the law's abusers.
Sister Cities. After years of estrangement, four sisters gather in the wake of their mother's death, which may or may not have been a suicide.
The Battle of Midway. Director John Ford captures combat footage of the Battle of Midway, an air and sea campaign that was a turning point in the war in the Pacific.
Virunga. The Oscar-nominated true story of the rangers risking their lives to save Africa's most precious national park and its endangered gorillas.
Happy as Lazzaro. Purehearted teen Lazzaro is content living as a sharecropper in rural Italy, but an unlikely friendship with the marquise's son will change his world.
The Seventies. This series examines 1970s America, focusing on the major political and historical landmarks of the decade and the cultural response to those events.
Trikal (Past, Present, Future). A Goan native returns to his now-derelict, palatial childhood home, recalling his family’s interpersonal drama during the end of Portuguese rule.
Sling Blade. A man returns home after being released from a psychiatric hospital, where he'd been confined since age 12 for murdering his mother and her lover.
Benji: Off the Leash. Benji is back in this charming story that's told from the pooch's point of view, tracking his early days as a pup to his current life in showbiz.
Is Love Enough? Sir. A young widow is hired as the domestic helper for a wealthy architect, but social divides come to the fore as an unlikely attraction grows between them.

titulo: Chhota Bheem & Krishna: Pataliputra- City of the Dead
texto: Chhota Bheem & Krishna: Pataliputra- City of the Dead. Krishna needs Bheem’s help: The ruined city of Pataliputra has been cursed! Can the friends do what it takes to bring light back into this town?
Mindhorn. When a twisted killer tells the police he'll only speak to a fictional 1980s TV detective, the washed-up actor who played him takes the gig.
El Cartel. One man makes a fateful decision to get involved with a Colombian drug cartel in this series based on a novel by Andrés López López.
A Chaster Marriage. Forced to wed his childhood friend, a man obsessed with football attempts to get rid of his wife in order to keep the woman he truly loves.
Save Me. Four young men come to the rescue of a former classmate whose family has been sucked into the clutches of a religious cult and its charismatic leader.
The Dukes of Hazzard. The Duke boys are back in this comedy based on the TV series, following Bo and Luke as they tear around Hazzard County in their trusty Dodge Charger.
The Writer. When accused of a murder eerily parallel to a plot in his novel, a best-selling crime writer must navigate a web of hidden enemies.
Criminal: Spain. Psychological games abound between detectives and suspects in a tense interrogation room, where the search for answers sometimes comes at a moral cost.
Great Yellowstone Thaw. This series explores the effects of the extreme temperature variations at Yellowstone National Park on the animals that live there.
72 Dangerous Animals: Asia. From fangs to claws to venomous stings, they all wield deadly weapons. But which creature will be crowned the fiercest of all?
Borderline. A team of inept border agents tackles immigration issues at the fictional Northend Airport in this improvised mockumentary series.
Bunk'd. The Ross siblings of Disney's hit series "Jessie" spend a summer full of fun and adventure at Maine's Camp Kikiwaka, where their parents first met.
Phir Se. The paths of a man and a woman, who have both been recently divorced from their spouses, intersect at an art exhibition in London.
Kath and Kim. As Kath prepares to wed fine-meats purveyor Kel, her daughter Kim moves back home after becoming disillusioned with her two-month marriage to Brett.
President. An ambitious, talented politician embarks on an intense journey toward winning the presidency while juggling his complicated family affairs.
The Son. In this psychological thriller, painter Lorenzo's life spirals out of control as he fears his wife is trying to isolate him from their infant son.
Miracle in Cell No. 7. Separated from his daughter, a father with an intellectual disability must prove his innocence when he is jailed for the death of a commander's child.
Sohni Mahiwal. After being violently separated from the woman he loves, a young man must disguise himself in order to keep meeting her.
Wish Dragon. Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.
Firedrake the Silver Dragon. When his home is threatened by humans, a young dragon summons the courage to seek a mythical paradise where dragons can live in peace and fly free.
XXx. A notorious underground rush-seeker deemed untouchable by the law is coerced into cooperating with the government to infiltrate a Russian crime ring.
Time Is Illmatic. Providing a behind-the-scenes look at the making of Nas's debut album, this documentary also delves into his deep connection to his New York roots.
Flowers. Between a troubled marriage, a senile granny and twin siblings constantly in rivalry, a crumbling household struggles to barely keep it together.
Five Elements Ninjas. When five ninjas whose fighting styles are based on natural elements unleash their fury on a rival school, a lone survivor vows deadly revenge.
Moonwalkers. A brain-addled war vet, a failing band manager and a Stanley Kubrick impersonator help the CIA construct an epic scam by faking the 1969 moon landing.
Danger Mouse: Classic Collection. Follow the adventures of superspy Danger Mouse and his bumbling sidekick, Penfold, as they jet around the world foiling their enemies' evil plots.
Prison Playbook. With his major league baseball debut right around the corner, a star pitcher lands in prison and must learn to navigate his new world.
Five Came Back. Five acclaimed contemporary directors tell the story of five legendary Hollywood filmmakers who enlisted in the armed forces to document World War II.
Magical Andes. From Argentina to Colombia, this stunning documentary follows five characters who share their deep connection to South America's majestic mountains.
Time Trap. While searching for their missing archaeology professor, a group of students discovers a cave where time passes differently than it does on the surface.
Santa Clarita Diet. They're ordinary husband and wife realtors until she undergoes a dramatic change that sends them down a road of death and destruction. In a good way.

titulo: The Power of Grayskull: The Definitive History of He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
texto: The Power of Grayskull: The Definitive History of He-Man and the Masters of the Universe. This colorful documentary explores the origins and impact of He-Man, a character whose power stretched well beyond a toy line and children's TV show.
The Great Gambler. After unwittingly using his skills to obtain military secrets, a gambler is pursued by a police officer who happens to be his doppelgänger.
Pineapple Express. After witnessing a murder, a perpetually stoned process server and his good-natured dealer go on the run from a drug lord who's out to kill them.
Bratz: The Movie. When high school hierarchy divides four best friends into different cliques, the girls defy expectations and try to bring their groups together.

titulo: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend
texto: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend. It's an interactive Kimmy special! Kimmy's getting married, but first she has to foil the Reverend's evil plot. It's your move: What should she do next?
Orange Is the New Black. A privileged New Yorker ends up in a women's prison when a past crime catches up with her in this Emmy-winning series from the creator of "Weeds."
Broadchurch. After a young boy is murdered in the small seaside town of Broadchurch, local detectives Ellie Miller and Alec Hardy are assigned the mysterious case.

titulo: Carmen Sandiego: To Steal or Not to Steal
texto: Carmen Sandiego: To Steal or Not to Steal. You drive the action in this interactive adventure, helping Carmen save Ivy and Zack when V.I.L.E. captures them during a heist in Shanghai.
Hope Springs Eternal. When a teen with terminal cancer miraculously finds herself in remission, she struggles to give up the attention her illness gave her at school.
The Danish Girl. In 1920s Denmark, married artists embark on a journey of unconditional love when the husband announces his intentions to live life as a woman.
Monster High: Freaky Fusion. When Frankie Stein travels back in time, a teen scientist follows her home into the present and causes a lab accident that creates four new monsters.
Dayveon. Following the shooting death of his older brother, a depressed and aimless 13-year-old boy falls in with a gang in rural Arkansas.
12 Years Promise. A pregnant teen is forced by her family to leave her boyfriend and assume a new identity in America, but 12 years later, the couple reunites in Korea.
Force 2. An ex-cop investigates the death of his best friend and two other spies, killings that lead to a mole operating from India's embassy in Budapest.
David Foster: Off the Record. From child prodigy to iconic music producer, David Foster shares the stories behind his success with rare footage and interviews with his collaborators.
Paris Is Burning. This Sundance prize-winning documentary is an intimate portrait of 1980s Harlem drag balls: a world of fierce competition, sustenance, and survival.
(T)ERROR. This real-life look at FBI counterterrorism operations features access to both sides of a sting: the government informant and the radicalized target.
Gosford Park. In this witty whodunit, wealthy guests and their servants gather for a weekend stay at the home of Sir William McCordle, who is soon found murdered.

titulo: Bruno and Boots: This Can't Be Happening at Macdonald Hall
texto: Bruno and Boots: This Can't Be Happening at Macdonald Hall. The biggest troublemakers at Macdonald Hall are Bruno and Boots, who are caught and face an unthinkable punishment: separation into different dorms.
Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie. Disaster-prone Mr. Bean is sent to Los Angeles to guard a famous painting, but as he's unfit for any physical task, everything goes hilariously wrong.
Touch Your Heart. Hoping to make a comeback after a bad scandal, an actress agrees to research a new role by taking a job as a secretary for a prickly attorney.
El club de los insomnes. An insomniac, an aspiring photographer and a pregnant veterinarian form a unique friendship during late-night meetings at a 24-hour mini-mart.
NOVA: Poisoned Water. This documentary details how the water disaster in Flint, Michigan happened, its lasting effects, and the lengthy efforts it took to correct it.
Man to Man. Disguised as a bodyguard, a special agent must complete his national secret tasks while pandering to the whims of his ill-tempered world star.
San Pietro. After the Allies invade Italy, the Liri Valley town of San Pietro becomes an example of the brutal effects of combat, both for soldiers and civilians.
El Chavo. El Chavo is a poor, nameless orphan who lives in an apartment building with La Chilindrina, Quico, Doña Florinda, Don Ramón and Professor Jirafales.

titulo: The Crystal Calls Making the Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance
texto: The Crystal Calls Making the Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance. Go behind the scenes with stars, puppeteers and creators as they bring Jim Henson's magical world of Thra back to life in a sweeping fantasy series.
Straight Up. When a gay brainiac with OCD questions his identity, he enters a romantic relationship with a woman, leaving sex and physical intimacy out of it.
The Valhalla Murders. An Oslo detective with a painful past returns to his native Iceland to help a dedicated cop hunt a serial killer with a link to a mysterious photo.
MR. RIGHT. Fresh off a bad relationship, thrill-seeking Martha finds romance and danger with Francis, a hit man who's decided to turn the tables on his clients.
Know Your Enemy - Japan. Though culturally insensitive by modern standards, this propaganda film examines the history of Japan from the 16th century through the 1930s.
Examination of Conscience. Allegations of child sexual abuse in Spain's Catholic institutions are examined in interviews with survivors, clergy, journalists and other experts.
The Black Prince. After being exiled to England as a child, a Punjabi prince struggles to return to his homeland and his Sikh faith in this historical drama.
The Lovebirds. When a couple in the fast lane to splitsville accidentally careens into a murder, they take off on a wild race to find the killer and clear their names.
Big Kill. A tenderfoot and two gamblers seeking their fortunes in a boom town instead find themselves defending it from a gunslinging preacher and his gang.
Miss in Kiss. A quirk of fate sends an ordinary, sweet-natured high school girl and her father into the home of the school genius, on whom she has a huge crush.
Prince of Peoria. A prankster prince who wants to experience life as an ordinary teen leaves his kingdom to live incognito with a single mom and her studious son.
Oh My Ghost 2. The spirited trio are back to take on a new ghost-busting adventure at a mens' residence, where spooky secrets lurk around every corner.
The Vanished. When their daughter disappears during a family vacation, two terrified parents launch their own investigation that soon exposes local secrets.
El desconocido. Based on real events, the fictional story of Mexican drug lord El Chato's number one hitman, El Cholo.
Camp Cool Kids. A young boy attends summer camp, where he overcomes his fears, stands up to bullies and learns important lessons about faith and life.
Thor: Tales of Asgard. Thor, the Marvel comic book character, comes to life in this animated feature that explores his earliest adventures with his brother Loki.
Trimurti. After being framed, a policewoman languishing in prison hopes that her three sons will deliver justice and restore her honor.
School of Rock. Musician Dewey Finn gets a job as a fourth-grade substitute teacher, where he secretly begins teaching his students the finer points of rock 'n' roll.
Night in Paradise. Hiding out in Jeju Island following a brutal tragedy, a wronged mobster with a target on his back connects with a woman who has her own demons.
The Mess You Leave Behind. A teacher starts her job at a high school but is haunted by a suspicious death that occurred there weeks before... and begins fearing for her own life.
Jindua. An Indian man in Canada marries a local citizen to legalize his immigration status. The only problem? His girlfriend isn't thrilled about his new wife.
Hell or High Water. In a desperate bid to save their family ranch, two brothers stage a series of clever bank robberies with a pair of Texas Rangers in hot pursuit.
Hostages. Witnesses recount the shocking 1996 hostage crisis in Lima, Peru, where rebels held scores of high-level figures captive at an ambassador's residence.
Neruda. When a Chilean policeman vows to find and capture leftist poet Pablo Neruda, a game of cat and mouse ensues that tests both their wills.
Bodyguard. Irked by her bodyguard, an heiress invents a secret admirer to throw him off his duties, but the plan may backfire when she falls for him.

titulo: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
texto: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta. The life and career of a lawyer are thrown into chaos when his son's wish magically renders him incapable of telling a lie.
A 3 Minute Hug. This documentary captures the joy and heartbreak of families separated by the U.S.-Mexico border sharing a short but bittersweet reunion in 2018.
Christmas With A View. Still reeling from a business failure, the restaurant manager of a ski resort finds her world jolted by a new chef, who has his own hidden past.

titulo: Parrot Sketch Not Included: Twenty Years of Monty Python
texto: Parrot Sketch Not Included: Twenty Years of Monty Python. Presented by Steve Martin, this anthology draws from “Flying Circus” and “Fliegender Zirkus” to mark the 20th anniversary of the TV series.
Snowpiercer. The Earth's remaining inhabitants are confined to a single train circling the globe as revolution brews among the class-divided cars.
Not a Game. This documentary offers an honest look at our fraught, complex relationship to video games from the perspectives of gamers and their concerned parents.
Candy Jar. Dueling high school debate champs who are at odds on just about everything forge ahead with ambitious plans to get into the colleges of their dreams.
Most Beautiful Thing. A 1950s housewife goes to Rio de Janeiro to meet up with her husband, only to learn he's deserted her, but decides to stay and open a bossa nova club.
Law School. When a grim incident occurs at their prestigious school, justice through law is put to a test by a tough law professor and his ambitious students.
Game Winning Hit. An army deserter hiding out in a small coastal town becomes the coach of a youth baseball team and develops warm relationships in his new community.

titulo: Inside the Mind of a Serial Killer
texto: Inside the Mind of a Serial Killer. Mixing dramatic re-enactments with real-life footage, this series delves into the tormented psyches of the world's most infamous serial killers.
My Little Baby. A top detective in the violent crimes unit becomes the sole guardian of his 6-month-old niece when his sister and her husband pass away unexpectedly.
Nigerian Prince. When a stubborn American teenager is sent to Nigeria by his mother, his cousin's scamming business becomes a viable option for securing a return flight.
Rounders. A law student befriends and "befoes" a fellow gambling addict and a club owner, and tensions run high when they must come up with $15k in just 5 days.
Pieces of a Woman. A heartbreaking home birth leaves a woman grappling with the profound emotional fallout, isolated from her partner and family by a chasm of grief.
The Bare-Footed Kid. While working at a family friend's business, a penniless orphan draws the attention of a corrupt competitor and is torn between divided loyalties.
Life 2.0. Computer users across the globe log onto the virtual world of Second Life. But some users' lives are dramatically consumed by this alternate reality.
Boca Juniors Confidential. Players, fans and staff of soccer powerhouse Boca Juniors provide an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at Argentina's legendary club.
Stretch Armstrong: The Breakout. Villains are rampaging through Charter City and the Flex Fighters – Jake, Ricardo and Nathan – need your help to halt the chaos.
In Family I Trust. After her partner cheats on her, an architect returns to her hometown to reassess her life with the help of her eccentric family. Based on the novel.
The Witcher. Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster-hunter for hire, journeys toward his destiny in a turbulent world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.
Open Season: Scared Silly. When a spooky werewolf tale scares Boog out of joining the annual camping trip, his friends hatch a plan to cure him of his fear.
Solomon Kane. In this epic tale, a once-murderous sea captain is holed up in a monastery in retreat from the devil, whom the captain fears is coming for his soul.
Nathicharami. Reeling from the loss of her husband, a widow struggles to fulfill her physical and emotional desires despite social taboos around female sexuality.
Benji. A determined dog comes to the rescue and helps heal a broken family when a young boy and his sister stumble into some serious danger.
You're My Destiny. A young woman's romantic cruise ends in a twist when she gets pregnant after a one-night stand with a rich executive, turning their lives upside down.
Space Force. A four-star general begrudgingly teams up with an eccentric scientist to get the U.S. military's newest agency — Space Force — ready for lift-off.
Maps to the Stars. A showbiz family revolving around its teen celebrity son desperately tries to hang on to fame and success in this savage satire of Hollywood.
Bad Blood. This sprawling crime drama follows the true story of the Rizzuto family and its associates, who presided over organized crime in Montreal for decades.

titulo: Miles Davis: Birth of the Cool
texto: Miles Davis: Birth of the Cool. Unpack the mythology of Miles Davis and learn the true story of a jazz legend with never-before-seen footage and celebrity interviews.
Four Seasons in Havana. As Havana slowly revolves through the year, wistful detective Mario Conde probes the sultry heart of the city to investigate dark and deadly crimes.
I Care a Lot. A court-appointed legal guardian defrauds her older clients and traps them under her care. But her latest mark comes with some unexpected baggage.
Criminal: France. Secrets emerge and entire cases unravel inside a police interview room in Paris, where suspects and investigators face off in an intricate dance.
Iverson. This unfiltered documentary follows the rocky life and stratospheric career of Allen Iverson, an NBA icon who left an indelible mark on the sport.
Buffalo Boys. Two Indonesian brothers learn the ways of the American cowboy before returning home to avenge the murder of their father.
Mutant Busters. After a natural disaster known as the Big Fart leaves Earth divided, only Sheriff and his rebel misfits can protect the planet from a mutant invasion.
Ghost Whispers. Freed of her responsibilities for the 501 Organization, Motoko must now learn how to take orders from Aramaki.
7:19. After a devastating earthquake hits Mexico City, trapped survivors from all walks of life wait to be rescued while trying desperately to stay alive.
A Leaf of Faith. This documentary takes a deep dive into the benefits, dangers and lingering questions around Kratom leaf as an alternative to opioid painkillers.
USS Indianapolis: Men of Courage. After becoming stranded in the Philippine Sea during World War II, a tenacious Navy crew faces a dire lack of supplies and a string of shark attacks.
The Brothers Grimm. Brothers Jake and Will Grimm travel from village to village, posing as exterminators of magical creatures. But in reality, they're expert con artists.
Russian Doll. Nadia keeps dying and reliving her 36th birthday party. She's trapped in a surreal time loop – and staring down the barrel of her own mortality.
Unicorn Store. After failing out of art school and taking a humdrum office job, a whimsical painter gets a chance to fulfill her lifelong dream of adopting a unicorn.
Rhyme Time Town. Fun-loving friends Daisy and Cole use music and imagination to solve problems in a town filled with nursery rhyme characters.
The Mechanism. A scandal erupts in Brazil during an investigation of alleged government corruption via oil and construction companies. Loosely inspired by true events.

titulo: DreamWorks Kung Fu Panda Awesome Secrets
texto: DreamWorks Kung Fu Panda Awesome Secrets. In this pair of adventures, Po tells the story of how masters Thundering Rhino, Storming Ox and Croc met and takes on Shifu's biggest challenge yet.

titulo: Put Your Head on My Shoulder
texto: Put Your Head on My Shoulder. On the cusp of graduation, an accounting major searching for her career winds up living with a genius physics student who shakes up her daily routine.
Wild Wild West. Armed with an ingenious arsenal, two top-notch government agents are tasked with tracking down a diabolical scientist in this futuristic Western.
Judwaa. Separated at birth, a pair of identical twins unexpectedly reunite as adults and embark on a madcap mission to take down a common enemy from their past.
Rising Phoenix. Elite athletes and insiders reflect on the Paralympic Games and examine how they impact a global understanding of disability, diversity and excellence.
Secret Affair. A married middle-aged woman is swept off her feet, both romantically and artistically, by a gifted young pianist.
Eastsiders. Cal turns to his friends for help through a hilariously dark time when he discovers that his partner Thom's been cheating on him.
Patient Seventeen. A surgeon claims to remove high tech microchips that aliens used to manipulate the human race. This documentary seeks to separate fact from fiction.
The Spy. In the 1960s, Israeli clerk-turned-secret agent Eli Cohen goes deep undercover inside Syria on a perilous, years-long mission to spy for Mossad.
Must Be... Love. When a teenage girl develops romantic feelings for her childhood best friend, she finds herself changing her ways to win him over.
The Trip to Spain. Comedians Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon gorge on local delicacies and celebrity impressions as they reunite for a hilarious road trip through Spain.
Elstree 1976. Then and now footage of bit players who appeared in "Star Wars" tells the story of how the film and its legions of fans changed their lives forever.
No Direction Home: Bob Dylan. Featuring rare concert footage and interviews with legendary musicians, this documentary traces Bob Dylan's life story and extraordinary career.

titulo: Seven Souls in the Skull Castle: Season Bird
texto: Seven Souls in the Skull Castle: Season Bird. Japan, 1590. Wandering samurai band together to take on the lord of Skull Castle in this “Bird” version of the dynamic show performed in a 360º theater.
The Silence of the Marsh. While researching corruption for his new book, a successful crime novelist shades the line between fiction and reality.
Yes, God, Yes. A devoutly religious teen grapples with her own sexual awakening, and attends a Catholic school retreat in the hopes of suppressing her newfound urges.
Woodstock. For the 50th anniversary of the legendary Woodstock festival, organizers and attendees reminisce about one of the defining moments of the 1960s.
The Siege of Jadotville. Besieged by overwhelming enemy forces, Irish soldiers on a U.N. peacekeeping mission in Africa valiantly defend their outpost in this true story.
ICarly. A cyberstar is born when 13-year-old Carly creates an Internet series with a little help from her best friend Sam and neighbor Freddie.
The Week Of. Two fathers with clashing views about their children's upcoming wedding struggle to keep it together during the chaotic week before the big day.
American Assassin. After grad student Mitch Rapp suffers a tragic loss during a terrorist attack, his single-minded thirst for vengeance catches the interest of the CIA.
The Alcàsser Murders. New interviews and an up-to-date analysis of evidence shed light on the 1992 murders of three girls in Spain and their profound impact on the nation.

titulo: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay
texto: Harold & Kumar Escape from Guantanamo Bay. Harold and Kumar jump on a plane to catch up with Harold's love interest but must change their plans when Kumar is accused of being a terrorist.
Menashe. A year after his wife's death, a widower faces pressure from his Hasidic community to give up his son for adoption unless he finds a new partner.
Rock the Kasbah. When a has-been music producer gets stuck in Afghanistan he discovers a girl with a wonderful voice, then has to find a way to market her talents.
Nature's Great Race. Epic footage captures three of the world's most significant land migrations, following elephants, caribou and zebras on their treacherous journeys.
Gameboys Level-Up Edition. In this recut of the popular web series, live-stream gamer Cairo calls for a rematch after losing to newcomer Gavreel — and an online romance blooms.
Good Hair. Chris Rock hops around the world going from beauty salons to science labs to comb through the mystery of Black hair.
Marshall. This biopic of Thurgood Marshall, the first Black U.S. Supreme Court justice, centers on his pivotal work in a sensational case as an NAACP lawyer.
Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani. A young man's obsession with making others happy drives him to help the girl he loves marry someone else, then try to win her heart.
The Healing Powers of Dude. When an 11-year-old boy with social anxiety disorder starts middle school, he finds strength in a scruffy emotional support dog named Dude.
Notes on Blindness. Based on the audio diaries of academic and theologian John Hull, this film offers an impressionistic re-creation of his slow descent into blindness.
Forensic. A pair of officers with history navigates clues from the past, false leads and a ticking clock to nab an elusive serial killer who targets young girls.
Last Tango in Halifax. Two widowed childhood sweethearts fall for each other all over again when they are reunited over the Internet after nearly 60 years.
Naa Bangaaru Talli. A father leading a dark double life and his daughter, who's eager to pursue her studies in Hyderabad, face the tragic consequences of sex trafficking.
Scarecrow. When his former partners vote to sell off a pricey piece of stolen jewelry, a thief recruits his grandson to help him retain it and repent for his deed.
Not Another Teen Movie. On a bet, a gridiron hero at John Hughes High School sets out to turn a bespectacled artist into a prom queen in this outrageous parody.

titulo: Digs & Discoveries: All Track's Lead to Rome
texto: Digs & Discoveries: All Track's Lead to Rome. After being introduced to Italy's ancient history, Thomas sets out to prove his expertise until his curiosity lands him in trouble in an old mine.
Tremors 5: Bloodline. When he is hired to capture a deadly creature terrorizing South Africa, survivalist Burt Gummer brings along a new tech-savvy partner.
Spring Breakers. Four cash-strapped college women run afoul of the law — and fall in with a shady hustler — as they join the annual rite of bikinis, beer and debauchery.

titulo: Spy Kids: All the Time in the World
texto: Spy Kids: All the Time in the World. Twins Rebecca and Cecil spring into action with their retired secret agent stepmother to stop a time-manipulating mastermind and his nefarious plans.
The Chosen. In 1937, Spanish revolutionary Ramón trains as a Soviet spy, impersonating a wealthy Belgian as part of a plot to assassinate Leon Trotsky in Mexico.
Secrets of Scotland Yard. Revisit famous cases and explore the history of Scotland Yard, one of the world's oldest detective forces and a name synonymous with crime solving.
Shattered Memories. When her former lover's mysteriously murdered, a woman must clear her name – and avoid the killer.
Crossroads: One Two Jaga. In Kuala Lumpur, an abused domestic worker tries to escape to Indonesia, while an idealistic cop insists on fighting corruption – at a heavy price.
West Beirut. Three intrepid teens roam the streets of Beirut in the midst of civil war, filming on a Super 8 camera and reckoning with the pains of growing up.
Amy. Rare home videos and interviews with Amy Winehouse's inner circle offer an intimate look at her journey from charismatic teen to troubled star.
The Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus. When a deal with the devil comes due, the immortal Doctor Parnassus must renegotiate the pact to save his daughter and right the wrongs of his past.
1994. Archival video and new interviews examine Mexican politics in 1994, a year marked by the rise of the EZLN and the assassination of Luis Donaldo Colosio.
El testigo. Colombian photojournalist Jesús Abad Colorado shares the stories behind a series of civil war photographs he captured throughout the '80s and '90s.

titulo: Kevyn Aucoin: Beauty & the Beast in Me
texto: Kevyn Aucoin: Beauty & the Beast in Me. Makeup artist Kevyn Aucoin worked with top supermodels in the 1980s and 1990s. Personal videos merged with interviews provide a peek into his life.
Pororo - The Little Penguin. On a tiny island, Pororo the penguin has fun adventures with his friends Eddy the fox, Loopy the beaver, Poby the polar bear and Crong the dinosaur.
The Sleepover. What do you do if your parents are kidnapped by a crew of international thieves? You begin a wild overnight adventure — complete with spy gear.
Beast Legends. A diverse crew of experts dive deep into the origin stories of mythological monsters before building replicas of the creatures using 3D CGI technology.
Chef. After igniting a Twitter war with a well-known culinary critic, a Los Angeles chef packs his knives, heads home to Miami and opens a food truck.
Cooked. As he tries his hand at baking, brewing and braising, acclaimed food writer Michael Pollan explores how cooking transforms food and shapes our world.
Baaghi. A martial artist faces his biggest test when he has to travel to Bangkok to rescue the woman he loves from the clutches of his romantic rival.
The Christmas Project. Four brothers prepare for war when they're forced to deliver secret holiday gifts to the school bullies. But they soon learn kindness goes a long way.
One Take. Members of Thai girl group BNK48 share the ups and downs of preparing for the 6th Single Senbatsu General Election.
Sky Rojo. A fatal turn of events at a brothel sends three women haunted by their pasts on a wild run from their pimp and his henchmen.
Last Night. During an evening apart, married couple Joanna and Michael encounter tempting opportunities to cheat on each other with sexy acquaintances.
Uncle Naji in UAE. Two young Yemeni business partners decide to go on vacation in the UAE with a few local friends, but their fun trip soon turns terrifying.
Who Killed Malcolm X?. Decades after the assassination of African American leader Malcolm X, an activist embarks on a complex mission seeking truth in the name of justice.
Pranaam. Aspiring to fulfill his father’s dream and become a civil services officer, a young man loses his way upon becoming entangled with a criminal lynchpin.
Small Town Crime. When a disgraced ex-cop discovers a dying woman, he's compelled to track down her killer — an act of self-redemption that takes him down a dark path.
The Circle - The Afterparty. Stars of "The Circle" drop by to discuss Season 2's big winner, some juicy behind-the-scenes gossip and their enduring friendships with one another.
Hyper HardBoiled Gourmet Report. To live is to eat. For people around the world in precarious and dangerous circumstances, eating itself is dangerous, precarious – and essential.
Our Souls at Night. After widowed neighbors Addie and Louis begin sleeping in bed together platonically to alleviate their loneliness, a real romance begins to blossom.
Centaurworld. On a quest to reunite with her trusty rider, a fearless war horse journeys through a whimsical world filled with magic, adventure and singing centaurs.
Rabun. A free-spirited couple leave the city to retire in the country. But when they're swindled by a relative, life in the countryside loses its luster.
Chasing Coral. Divers, scientists and photographers around the world mount an epic underwater campaign to document the disappearance of coral reefs.
Rookie Historian Goo Hae-Ryung. Free spirit Goo Hae-ryung embarks on a new life as a scholar in the Joseon royal court after hearing about a government post for women historians.
Hart of Dixie. Fast-talking city girl Zoe Hart winds up patching up the locals of a tiny town in the Deep South when she inherits a medical practice in Alabama.

titulo: Guatemala: Heart of the Mayan World
texto: Guatemala: Heart of the Mayan World. From Sierra de las Minas to Esquipulas, explore Guatemala's cultural and geological wealth, including ancient Mayan cities and other natural wonders.
Sherlock. In this updated take on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's beloved mystery tales, the eccentric sleuth prowls the streets of modern London in search of clues.

titulo: The Magic School Bus Rides Again Kids In Space
texto: The Magic School Bus Rides Again Kids In Space. The Magic School Bus kids blast into orbit — and onto the International Space Station — only to find themselves on the run from a giant tardigrade!
ReMastered: Massacre at the Stadium. The shocking murder of singer Victor Jara in 1973 turned him into a powerful symbol of Chile's struggle. Decades later, a quest for justice unfolds.
Super Monsters Back to School. The Super Monsters welcome Vida to her new home in Pitchfork Pines with a tour of their favorite places, then help her through her first day at school.
Beneath the Leaves. An escaped psychopathic child killer faces off against one of his former victims, who has since become a hard-nosed detective.
Betaal. Hired to displace tribal villagers to make way for a new highway, officials unearth an old curse and an army of British soldier-zombies.
Birthmarked. In an attempt to settle the "nature vs. nurture" debate, a scientist couple raises three children to live lives that defy their genetic dispositions.
Lucifer. Bored with being the Lord of Hell, the devil relocates to Los Angeles, where he opens a nightclub and forms a connection with a homicide detective.
Star Men. Four astronomers from England celebrate 50 years of friendship and achievement by taking a reflective road trip through the American Southwest.

titulo: It Takes a Man and a Woman
texto: It Takes a Man and a Woman. Laida and Miggy used to be in love, but now they're forced to work together in a professional capacity – and neither is completely over their past.
The History of Future Folk. An alien ordered to colonize Earth abandons his mission when he hears music for the first time and is determined to save his adopted planet.
The Take. After a mix-up lands him in hot water, a skilled pickpocket is forced to help a no-nonsense CIA operative track a terrorist group in Paris.
Talking Tom and Friends. Full of funny one-liners and always ready for an adventure, a talking cat and his equally chatty animal cohorts set out to become famous.
Grease. John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John star in this hit musical comedy about a greaser and the good girl he falls for – much to his friends' chagrin.
Don't Go Breaking My Heart. A financial analyst succumbs to a love triangle with a hard-drinking architect and a promiscuous investment bro, who soon becomes her boss.
The Bomb. Form, montage and mesmerizing kinetics propel this experimental meditation on the destructive power of the nuclear bomb, featuring music by The Acid.

titulo: Murder to Mercy: The Cyntoia Brown Story
texto: Murder to Mercy: The Cyntoia Brown Story. After 16-year-old Cyntoia Brown is sentenced to life in prison, questions about her past, physiology and the law itself call her guilt into question.

titulo: The Man Who Would Be Polka King
texto: The Man Who Would Be Polka King. This irreverent documentary reveals how charming entertainer Jan Lewan bilked investors out of millions in a complicated investment scam.
The Babysitter: Killer Queen. Two years after Cole survived a satanic blood cult, he's living another nightmare: high school. And the demons from his past? Still making his life hell.
Behind Her Eyes. A single mother enters a world of twisted mind games when she begins an affair with her psychiatrist boss while secretly befriending his mysterious wife.
Swearnet Live. "Trailer Park Boys" John Paul Tremblay, Robb Wells and Mike Smith host this foulmouthed live kick-off of their Web-based Swearnet network.
Toilet: Ek Prem Katha. On her first day of marriage, a woman leaves her husband upon learning his home lacks a toilet, sparking a quixotic quest to acquire modern sanitation.
Bogda. An aspiring dancer accompanies her terminally ill mother on one last road trip that alternately strains and strengthens their knotty relationship.
Mighty Little Bheem. An innocent toddler’s boundless curiosity – and extraordinary might – lead to mischief and adventure in his small Indian town.

titulo: Amelia: A Tale of Two Sisters
texto: Amelia: A Tale of Two Sisters. Eight decades after her disappearance, Amelia Earhart's incredible accomplishments are still celebrated, thanks in large part to her sister Muriel.
A Kid from Coney Island. From gifted athlete to professional NBA hooper, Coney Island's Stephon Marbury navigates the pressures, pitfalls and peaks of his basketball journey.
We Belong Together. A divorced professor shares a night of passion with a troubled student who quickly develops an unhealthy – perhaps deadly – infatuation.
Wentworth. Bea Smith is locked up while awaiting trial for the alleged attempted murder of her husband and must learn how life works in prison.
Black Is Beltza. A young Basque man is radicalized in 1960s America after being forbidden from participating in a parade on racial grounds.
Samantha!. A child star in the '80s, Samantha clings to the fringes of celebrity with hilarious harebrained schemes to launch herself back into the spotlight.

titulo: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland
texto: Blue Mountain State: The Rise of Thadland. New NFL star Thad buys his old teammates' beloved frat house, renames it Thadland and throws the raunchiest, most debauched party in school history.
Girls und Panzer der Film. The girls of Ōarai High must face off against a formidable university team in a fierce tank battle to once again avoid closure of their school.
Zero. A shy teen with the power to turn invisible must get it under control to help defend his neighborhood, putting aside the pursuit of his artistic dream.
Pablo Escobar: Angel or Demon?. This documentary traces the steps of druglord Pablo Escobar with vivid eyewitness accounts that reconstruct his bloody reign in Colombia.
Adventures in Public School. After years of home-schooling, an awkward teen decides he wants a public high school experience, but his overbearing mother struggles to let go.
Liberated: The New Sexual Revolution. Filmmakers explore how pop culture shapes a new generation's beliefs about gender, sexuality and violence on display among students on spring break.
Black Heart. Blaming a crooked media mogul for the death of his journalist sister, a surgeon enlists the help of a beautiful psychologist to get revenge.

titulo: InuYasha the Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island
texto: InuYasha the Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island. Ai, a young half-demon who has escaped from Horai Island to try to help her people, returns with potential saviors InuYasha, Sesshomaru and Kikyo.
The Surrounding Game. Teens in America dedicate themselves to the Asian game of Go, which originated in ancient China, drawing meaningful life lessons along the way.
Angels & Demons. A Harvard symbologist races to uncover clues that will help stop an attack on the Vatican by a secret society looking to retaliate for old persecutions.

titulo: Trip to Bhangarh: Asia's Most Haunted Place
texto: Trip to Bhangarh: Asia's Most Haunted Place. To amuse themselves, six college friends decide to pay a visit to a fortress believed by some to be the most haunted place in Asia.
Puffin Rock. Life is sweet on beautiful Puffin Rock, where puffling Oona, her baby brother Baba and their pals learn about nature, friendship and family.
Santana. Two brothers — one a narcotics agent and the other a general — finally discover the identity of the drug lord who murdered their parents decades ago.
Stowaway. A three-person crew on a mission to Mars faces an impossible choice when an unplanned passenger jeopardizes the lives of everyone on board.
Jonaki. In this quiet, wistful drama, a woman on her deathbed searches her fraying memories for love and fulfillment through surreal, meditative tableaux.
A Ghost Story. Following a fatal car crash, a man's spirit remains stuck in the home he shared with his wife as doors into the past and future begin to open.
Tum Milo Toh Sahi. An astute but old-fashioned law clerk steps up to help the owner of a cafe in a legal battle that has both business and personal ramifications.
Gabru: Hip Hop Revolution. Three young, aspiring Indian rappers make their way in a cutthroat music industry, dreaming of fame, stardom and ultimate hip-hop domination .
Evil Genius. This baffling true crime story starts with the grisly death of a pizza man who robs a bank with a bomb around his neck – and gets weirder from there.
Pup Academy. Furry friends take a re-bark-able journey in this series about an extraordinary school for the cutest, cuddliest and most curious puppies.

titulo: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc II - The Battle for Doldrey
texto: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc II - The Battle for Doldrey. For three years, Guts believed his mission was to pursue Griffith's dream together with him. But in order to become Griffith's equal and truly be called his friend, Guts realizes he will have to leave the Band of the Hawk.
Still LAUGH-IN: The Stars Celebrate. This celebration of the groundbreaking comedy show "Laugh-In" stars Lily Tomlin, Snoop Dogg, Billy Crystal, Tiffany Haddish, Neil Patrick Harris and more.
Hero. A pugilist from Shantung struggles to rise to the top of the Shanghai triad ladder, where his stellar martial arts talents can shine.
The Code. In this three-part documentary series, host Marcus du Sautoy examines the mathematical code underlying all of life on Earth and the universe itself.
Brown Nation. An Indian American man living with his artistic wife and contentious father-in-law struggles to handle his household and a foundering IT company.
Berlin Syndrome. What starts as a passionate one-night stand quickly turns sinister when Clare learns she's locked inside Andi's apartment with no way out.
Growing up and other problems. A 30-something woman without a steady partner or income samples stability when her pregnant best friend asks her to be the godmother of her child.
Aliens Stole My Body. The Galactic Patrol is on the hunt for Deputy Rod Allbright's body. Now they must team up with old and new friends to stop the body-snatching fiend.
The Hurt Business. Featuring legendary and up-and-coming MMA fighters, this documentary details the history of the brutal sport and the fighters' struggles and triumphs.
Christmas Wedding Planner. A wedding planner’s world is turned upside down when a handsome private investigator is hired to disrupt one of her biggest jobs.
Puerto Ricans in Paris. New York police detectives Luis and Eddie experience culture shock and adventure when they head to Paris to track down a stolen couture handbag.
The Heartbreak Kid. Ben Stiller stars as a newlywed who marries a dreamy woman, only to learn on their honeymoon that she's a total nightmare.
Gangs of New York. In the crime-ridden slums of New York in the 1860s, vengeful orphan Amsterdam Vallon joins the cutthroat gang of his father's killer, Bill the Butcher.
Unbroken. After the brutal murders of their loved ones, three individuals share how they healed through forgiveness in this documentary presented by Aamir Khan.

titulo: DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon Legends
texto: DreamWorks How to Train Your Dragon Legends. In this set of shorts, Hiccup and the gang learn about different species of dragons. Then, Gobber goes in search of the Boneknapper Dragon.
Rapture. Groundbreaking artists share their life stories in this vibrant documentary series that captures hip-hop's impact on global culture.
Reign. This vivid historical drama series tells of the rise to power of Mary, Queen of Scots, amid a court full of sexual and political intrigue.
Gigantosaurus. Four prehistoric friends go on an array of adventures while trying to unravel a mystery about a big, fierce creature. Based on Jonny Duddle's book.
The Emigrant. Ram leaves the nomadic life and embarks on a quest for knowledge in a pharaonic Egypt mired in political intrigue. Based on a biblical story.
Mudbound. Two Mississippi families – one black, one white – confront the brutal realities of prejudice, farming and friendship in a divided World War II era.
The Reservoir Game. An investigative reporter seeks to expose the whereabouts of a slush fund belonging to the former president of South Korea, Lee Myung-bak.
Barbie: Princess Charm School. Blair Willows is excited when she gets to go to Princess Charm School, where she meets princesses Delancy and Hadley, and searches for a magic crown.
Generation 56k. A chance encounter leads two 30-somethings to remember 1998, the year their teenage hormones kicked in — and the internet changed their lives forever.
LA Originals. Photographer Estevan Oriol and artist Mister Cartoon turned their Chicano roots into gritty art, impacting street culture, hip hop and beyond.
Suburra. A grueling battle over turning a seaside town near Rome into a gambling paradise exposes criminal rivalries and endemic corruption on a grand scale.
Going for Gold. After moving to Australia, an American teen convinces her new friends to form a cheer squad and take on their biggest rivals in competition.
Thelonious Monk: Straight, No Chaser. The spotlight shines on iconic jazz pianist and composer Thelonious Monk in this 1988 documentary featuring vintage performance clips and interviews.
Tayo and Little Wizards. Tayo speeds into an adventure when his friends get kidnapped by evil magicians invading their city in search of a magical gemstone.
The Long Dumb Road. Bound for art school, a sheltered student gets roped into the antics of a freewheeling mechanic who hitches a ride after fixing his car.
Puerta 7. A determined woman works to rid an Argentine soccer club of the violent crime and corruption surrounding its intense fanbase.
Illang: The Wolf Brigade. In 2029, the elite police squad Illang combats a terrorist group opposing reunification of the two Koreas. But another enemy may be lurking nearby.

titulo: Minimalism: A Documentary About the Important Things
texto: Minimalism: A Documentary About the Important Things. People dedicated to rejecting the American ideal that things bring happiness are interviewed in this documentary showing the virtues of less is more.
Spotless. The law-abiding owner of a crime scene cleaning service is forced into business with a powerful mob boss thanks to his irresponsible older brother.
The Hurricane Heist. A deadly hurricane with mile-high waves provides the perfect cover for stealing $600 million from a U.S. Treasury outpost in Mississippi.
P. King Duckling. P. King, the daring but hapless duck, teams up with best buddies Wombat and Chumpkins to find wacky and wild ways to solve their problems.
Newly Rich, Newly Poor. After learning they were switched at birth, wealthy Andrés and working-class Brayan must adjust to the families and lifestyles they were meant to have.
El Vato. Regional Mexican singer El Vato and his friends struggle to succeed in the enticing but deceptive music world in Los Angeles, California.
Road to Sangam. As communal violence erupts in his neighborhood, a Muslim mechanic presses forward to repair a historic truck that will transport Gandhi’s last remains.

titulo: Fate: The Winx Saga - The Afterparty
texto: Fate: The Winx Saga - The Afterparty. Stars of the fiery hit discuss the show's magic, play trivia and chow down on hot wings. Then, Taylor Tomlinson shares how she would use fairy powers.
Delhi Belly. Three flatmates get involved in the shady business belonging to one roomie's fiancé, and discover that a global crime syndicate is gunning for them.
Thi Mai. Along with her two friends, a determined woman travels to Vietnam to bring home the baby her recently deceased daughter had planned to adopt.

titulo: Motu Patlu in Hong Kong: Kung Fu Kings 3
texto: Motu Patlu in Hong Kong: Kung Fu Kings 3. With a dangerous villain to defeat in Hong Kong, Motu takes his martial arts skills to the next level, training with a boneless master to face the foe.
Victim Number 8. No one can be trusted after a terrorist bombing in Bilbao kills seven and destroys the lives of the suspected jihadi and everyone around him.
Q-Force. A gay superspy and his scrappy LGBTQ squad fight to prove themselves to the agency that underestimated them. Today, West Hollywood… tomorrow, the world!
THE RUM DIARY. Johnny Depp stars in this adaptation of Hunter S. Thompson's novel about a boozy journalist who moves to Puerto Rico and falls for a taken woman.
Expelled from Paradise. In the wake of a global catastrophe, the human survivors are "uploaded" into a cyber network, but someone or something is infiltrating the system.
Creeped Out. A masked figure known as "The Curious" collects tales of dark magic, otherworldly encounters and twisted technology in this kids anthology series.
ROAD TO ROMA. Director Alfonso Cuarón reflects on the childhood memories, period details and creative choices that shaped his Academy Award-winning film "ROMA."
Miss Representation. Explore how the mainstream media's often disparaging portrayals of women contribute to the under-representation of females in positions of leadership.
Goon: Last of the Enforcers. Injury and family push hockey player Doug Glatt into retirement, but his plans change when his beloved former team appoints his nemesis as captain.
The Outsider. An American soldier imprisoned in postwar Japan enters the dark world of the yakuza, adopting their way of life in repayment for his freedom.
Shameless (U.S.). This dramedy based on a British series centers on siblings in a dysfunctional Chicago family who struggle while coping with their alcoholic father.

titulo: Have You Ever Fallen in Love, Miss Jiang?
texto: Have You Ever Fallen in Love, Miss Jiang?. A new teacher finds herself in an unenviable situation after witnessing a troubling interaction between an administrator and a student.
Due Date. Days before his pregnant wife's due date, Peter lands on the "no-fly" list, forcing him to drive across the country with an irritating slacker.
Traitor. An FBI agent assigned to pursue an ex-Special Ops soldier who joined a terrorist organization begins to question his target's true intentions.
Murder Mountain. In Humboldt County, California, the big business of legal marijuana brings in visitors from around the world. Some are never seen again.

titulo: The Incredible Story of the Giant Pear
texto: The Incredible Story of the Giant Pear. Sebastian the elephant and his feline friend Mithco sail on a gigantic peach to rescue Sunnytown's beloved mayor, who's stranded on a mysterious island.
Bibi & Tina. Teen witch Bibi and horse-loving Tina face trouble when a posh girl flirts with Tina's boyfriend and a crook sets his greedy eyes on a promising foal.
Shine Your Eyes. A Nigerian musician travels to Brazil to search for his estranged brother, who is living a life very different than the one his family thought.
Amend: The Fight for America. Will Smith hosts this look at the evolving, often lethal, fight for equal rights in America through the lens of the US Constitution's 14th Amendment.
Beavis and Butt-head Do America. After realizing that their boob tube is gone, Beavis and Butt-head set off on an expedition that takes them from Las Vegas to the nation's capital.
Breaking Bad. A high school chemistry teacher dying of cancer teams with a former student to secure his family's future by manufacturing and selling crystal meth.
Adam: His Song Continues. After their child was abducted and murdered, John and Reve Walsh fought to raise national awareness of the problem of missing children.
Parks and Recreation. In this Emmy-nominated comedy, an employee with a rural Parks and Recreation department is full of energy and ideas but bogged down by bureaucracy.
Nature's Great Events: Diaries. Look behind the scenes of this wildlife documentary series that examines how animals around the world adapt to chaotic natural phenomena.
Lion Pride. After crossing paths at a crime scene, a renowned math teacher and an antiques appraiser embark on an unexpected journey of love and self-discovery.
The Blacklist. After turning himself in, a brilliant fugitive offers to help the FBI bag other baddies, but only if rookie profiler Elizabeth Keen is his partner.
Lego Friends. As a way to make friends, new girl in town Olivia volunteers to work at the Heartlake City World Petacular with four other girls.
Galih dan Ratna. Sparks fly between the new girl at school and the misfit with a passion for music. Yet the world threatens to put a stop to their innocent love song.
El Marginal. While investigating a kidnapping, an ex-cop sent to infiltrate a prison finds himself surrounded by dangerous felons who can't know his real identity.
Ram Dass, Going Home. From his home on Maui, pioneering researcher, author and spiritual teacher Ram Dass reflects on love, life and death as his own days draw to a close.
The Fierce Wife. Beautiful housewife Xie An Zhen seems to be living the perfect life but finds her world crumbling after learning that her husband is cheating on her.
February 9. As a psychology professor faces Alzheimer's, his daughter and her three close female friends experience romance, marriage, heartbreak and tragedy.
Recall. Struggling to move on from a heartbreaking loss, Mikey is drawn into a dangerous underworld robbery orchestrated by his unreliable stepbrother Dale.
Vientos de agua. José Olaya, a Spanish miner, emigrates to Argentina in 1934, while his son, an architect, moves to Spain after Argentina's economic collapse in 2001.
Krishna Cottage. True love is put to the test when another woman comes between a pair of star-crossed young lovers in this thriller.
The Company Men. A successful businessman comes face-to-face with America's downsizing epidemic when he loses his job and is forced to take a construction gig.
The Last Czars. When social upheaval sweeps Russia in the early 20th century, Czar Nicholas II resists change, sparking a revolution and ending a dynasty.
Victor. In 1962 Brooklyn, a Puerto Rican teen who joins a gang is seduced by violence and heroin. But can his mother's love and faith in God save him?
Mighty Little Bheem: Kite Festival. With winter behind them, Bheem and his townspeople usher in a sunny new season in all their favorite ways during the Makar Sankranti festival.
This Earth of Mankind. A Javanese royal and half-Dutch woman fall in love as Indonesia rises to independence from colonial rule. Based on Pramoedya Ananta Toer's famed novel.

titulo: Power Rangers Samurai: Clash of the Red Rangers
texto: Power Rangers Samurai: Clash of the Red Rangers. The Samurai Rangers team up with the RPM Ranger Red to fight off Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic villain from the RPM Ranger's dimension.
Playing Hard. Step inside the Ubisoft offices, and follow designer Jason VandenBerghe's fight to create the video game "For Honor" over four years.
Goldie & Bear. Best pals Goldie and Bear, from "Goldilocks and the Three Bears," join other characters from beloved stories for adventures in the Fairy Tale Forest.
Losing Sight of Shore. This documentary recounts the feats of the Coxless Crew, a team of four women who rowed from San Francisco to Australia in support of two charities.
World Trade Center. Working under treacherous conditions, an army of dedicated rescuers struggles to find anyone who survived the World Trade Center's tragic collapse.
What's Your Raashee?. To protect his family from ruin, Yogesh must marry his dream girl in only ten days, so he rushes into dating women with different astrological signs.
Hayat Öpücügü. High-strung Metin finally stops seeing doom and gloom around every corner when he meets vivacious Hayat, but she has her own soul-searching to do.
Don't Crack Under Pressure. There are risks. Then there are risk-takers. In an around-the-world trip, follow athletes perform jaw-dropping acts in unpredictable elements of nature.
You. Obsessed with an aspiring writer, a charming bookstore manager goes to extreme measures to insert himself into her life.
Camellia Sisters. Tensions rise and untold secrets surface for three royal sisters when a family treasure is stolen the night before an antique auction.

titulo: The Death and Life of Marsha P. Johnson
texto: The Death and Life of Marsha P. Johnson. As she fights the tide of violence against trans women, activist Victoria Cruz probes the suspicious 1992 death of her friend Marsha P. Johnson.
Mandela. Amid a local election with two rivals vying to win by any means necessary, a barber lands in a curiously powerful position as the single deciding vote.
Poms. After moving to a retirement community, loner Martha befriends a fun-loving neighbor and forms a cheerleading club for young-at-heart seniors.
Connected. Argentine DJ Hernán Cattáneo, known for his house music innovations, invites a symphonic orchestra for a four-night run at Buenos Aires' Teatro Colón.
Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd.. This offbeat comedy-drama follows six quirky newlywed couples as they set off on a bus from Mumbai to Goa on their honeymoons.
A Witches' Ball. Beatrix can't wait to be inducted as a witch, but an unfortunate incident threatens to take her pending title away if she doesn't act fast.
Koko: The Gorilla Who Talks. Witness the incredible, decades-long friendship between Koko the gorilla and Penny Patterson, who taught Koko to communicate via sign language.
Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV. King Regis of Lucis orders his Kingsglaive warriors to stop the army of Niflheim before it invades and steals the crystal that gives Lucis its power.
Internet Famous. Five viral Internet celebrities travel to a competition that will award one of them their own television series in this ensemble comedy.
Mad World. A stockbroker struggling with bipolar disorder goes to live with his estranged father in a cramped flat, where old resentments bubble to the surface.
Dear White People. Students of color navigate the daily slights and slippery politics of life at an Ivy League college that's not nearly as "post-racial" as it thinks.
This Is the Life. Examine how the group of alternative hip-hop artists known as the Good Lifers started a movement and created a robust, progressive musical community.

titulo: Hank: Five Years from the Brink
texto: Hank: Five Years from the Brink. From Joe Berlinger, director of the "Paradise Lost" trilogy, comes this documentary about controversial former U.S. Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson.
Brother in Love. A robbery leaves a proprietor penniless before his wedding, but becoming a son-in-law to a second family might be the financial solution he needs.
God of War. A maverick leader and a clever young general take on Japanese pirates amid bureaucratic intrigue in Ming Dynasty China.
Ek Hasina Thi. Imprisoned for underworld crimes she didn’t commit, a vengeful woman breaks free and goes scorched earth on the smooth-talking suitor who framed her.
André & his olive tree. As he prepares to close his restaurant, Michelin-starred Chef André Chiang embarks on a personal and emotional journey of reflection.
Barney and Friends. Barney the purple dinosaur, Baby Bop and B.J. are still bringing smiles to kids' faces with their nonstop adventures, stories, games and guests.
Tremors 2: Aftershocks. A rag-tag team of survivalists and scientists battle supersucking desert creatures that are worming their way through the oil fields of Mexico.
Standoff. After witnessing an assassin's slaughter, a young girl holes up in a farmhouse with a suicidal vet, who must use wits and guts to fend off the killer.
The Good Cop. When he's not solving murders, a pathologically honest detective tries to keep an eye on his crooked but kindhearted dad.
PILI Fantasy: War of Dragons. As turmoil looms in the Martial World, and the Eight Wonders of the Evil Dragon unleashes dark forces, who will emerge as the new warrior legend?
Into the Badlands. Dreaming of escaping to a distant city, a ferocious warrior and a mysterious boy tangle with territorial warlords and their highly trained killers.
American Outlaws. In the wake of the Civil War, Jesse James leads a feisty group of ranchers in a fight against a railroad baron bent on seizing their land at any cost.
Cocomong. What's in your fridge? In sunny Refrigerator Land, everyday ingredients transform into animal friends who love a good adventure.
Ask the Doctor. From allergies to diet to sleep, three friendly doctors share expert advice, bust medical myths and test the latest treatments.
Hotel Beau Séjour. Caught in an afterlife limbo, teenage Kato investigates her own mysterious death and unravels a web of secrets in her seemingly tranquil village.
The After Party. An aspiring rapper and his best friend/manager have one night to bounce back from embarrassment and make their dreams of hip-hop stardom come true.
Top 10 Secrets and Mysteries. This series investigates mysteries that persistently elude scientific explanation, such as mythical creatures, UFOs, sacred sites and more.

titulo: The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance
texto: The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance. As power-hungry overlords drain life from the planet Thra, a group of brave Gelfling unite on a quest to save their world and fight off the darkness.
Coraline. Curious young Coraline unlocks a door in her family's home and is transported to a universe that strangely resembles her own – only better.
Sex, Explained. From the biology of attraction to the history of birth control, explore the ins and outs of sex in this entertaining and enlightening series.

titulo: Clive Davis: The Soundtrack of Our Lives
texto: Clive Davis: The Soundtrack of Our Lives. This music-driven documentary charts Clive Davis' 50-year career as one of the world's most influential record moguls.
The Ghost and the Tout. Boisterous hustler Isla, whose life consists of brawling and drinking, acquires the ability to see ghosts, including the recently deceased Mike.

titulo: The Long Goodbye: The Kara Tippetts Story
texto: The Long Goodbye: The Kara Tippetts Story. Faced with terminal breast cancer, a courageous wife and mother turns her suffering into a resilient message of faith, love and compassion.
Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack. Thirteen years after the war, the Neo Zeon army threatens the peace. Armed with the Nu Gundam, Amuro Ray and Federation forces take the field once more.
Love & Anarchy. A married consultant and a young IT tech kick off a flirty game that challenges societal norms — and leads them to re-evaluate their entire lives.
Alt-Right: Age of Rage. This documentary follows a white power leader and an Antifa activist leading up to the Charlottesville riots in the first year of Trump's presidency.
The Legend of Cocaine Island. An urban legend about a duffel bag of cocaine buried in the Caribbean leads a misfit band to hatch a nutball plan to find it in this comic documentary.
Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle. An orphaned boy raised by animals in the jungle seizes his destiny while confronting a dangerous enemy – and his own human origins.
Edge of Seventeen. A 17-year-old confronts confusion and heartbreak as he rediscovers his sexuality in this story about coming out and its social consequences.
Hot Bot. Two teenage geeks inadvertently find a lifelike, state-of-the-art sex robot, but must dodge the high-profile owner who lost her in order to keep her.
Magnetic. Attracted to thrills across the globe, intrepid athletes venture to remote locations in pursuit of their extreme form of bliss.
Inception. A troubled thief who extracts secrets from people's dreams takes one last job: leading a dangerous mission to plant an idea in a target's subconscious.
Maniyarayile Ashokan. When his unlucky horoscope doesn’t bode well for his future wife, an earnest bachelor goes to surprising lengths to get the family he’s always wanted.
Buddy Thunderstruck. Follow the outrageous, high-octane adventures of Buddy Thunderstruck, a truck-racing dog who brings guts and good times to the town of Greasepit.
Qué pena tu serie. Javier is happily in love with Sofia, so when she breaks up their perfect life, he has to get her back – or maybe try finding a new perfect love.
