Class of '61. As the Civil War looms, a runaway slave seeks freedom, and West Point cadets find their camaraderie shattered as they choose between North or South.
The Mayo Clinic. A look at how a world-renowned medical institution prioritizes patients' needs and has adapted to healthcare's evolving demands for over 150 years.
Winter's Bone. In this unflinching noir drama, a resilient teen goes on the trail of her missing, drug-dealing father when his absence threatens the family's safety.
All Hallows' Eve. Instead of summoning the spirit of her dearly departed mother, a charming teen accidentally awakens a vengeful witch who wants to destroy her town.
Poster Boys. Three men are stunned to find their faces on a poster promoting vasectomies, and must prove to their upset loved ones that they're innocent victims.
Bhai: Vyakti Ki Valli - Uttarardh. The second installment of P.L. Deshpande’s biopic explores the Marathi humorist’s political journey, philanthropic endeavors and personal life.
Edge of the Universe. Leading astronomers reveal the latest discoveries about death-trap planets, asteroids, comets and other wonders of the cosmos.
MANK. 1930s Hollywood is reevaluated through the eyes of scathing wit and alcoholic screenwriter Herman J. Mankiewicz as he races to finish “Citizen Kane.”
Igor. Igor, the brilliant but deformed assistant to mad Dr. Glickenstein, dreams of winning the Evil Science Fair and the heart of village beauty Gretchen.
Life in the Doghouse. A couple operates a bustling dog rescue out of their own home, vowing to give a safe space to the neediest pups on the planet – 10,000 and counting.
Pegasus. After a five-year suspension, a once-legendary race car driver decides to get back in the game against a new generation of opponents.
Danny Says. This documentary profiles eccentric publicist Danny Fields, who helped launch the careers of innovative new artists who would become musical icons.

titulo: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
texto: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan. An evil demon who traded his freedom for immortality lures Chhota Bheem and his friends to the city of Sonapur with tales of hidden treasure.
Hard Lessons. This drama based on real-life events tells the story of George McKenna, the tough, determined new principal of a notorious Los Angeles high school.

titulo: Learning Songs by Little Baby Bum: Nursery Rhyme Friends
texto: Learning Songs by Little Baby Bum: Nursery Rhyme Friends. Simple songs mix with colorful animation to teach youngsters about concepts such as animals, vehicles, numbers, colors and more.
American Beauty. While struggling to endure his tightly wound wife, an unfulfilling job and a surly teen, a man becomes obsessed with one of his daughter's friends.

titulo: The Heyday of the Insensitive Bastards
texto: The Heyday of the Insensitive Bastards. An all-star cast brings to life the short stories of author Robert Boswell in this anthology series of vignettes set in modern-day America.
Transformers Prime. With the help of three human allies, the Autobots once again protect Earth from the onslaught of the Decepticons and their leader, Megatron.
The 100. A century after Earth was devastated by a nuclear apocalypse, 100 space station residents are sent to the planet to determine whether it's habitable.
Freezer's Campaign. When climate change makes Egypt freeze over, intelligence officers pose as a film crew on location to seek a device that can eliminate the frost.
The Laws of Thermodynamics. A physicist uses the laws of thermodynamics to describe romance and relationships, but his theories prove faulty when it comes to his own love life.
Occupied. In the near future, Russia initiates a "silk glove" invasion of Norway to restart oil production, but soon uncertainty, chaos and danger erupt.
The Last Kingdom. As Alfred the Great defends his kingdom from Norse invaders, Uhtred – born a Saxon but raised by Vikings – seeks to claim his ancestral birthright.
Mansfield Park. A poor heroine is sent to live with wealthy relatives in 1800s England, where her wit and writing talent find the room, and circumstance, to grow.
Mystic Pizza. In a small fishing town, three teenage girls from blue-collar families navigate life and love while working in a pizza parlor.
Hunters of the South Seas. In a far corner of the Pacific Ocean, people who live entirely at sea share insights into their incredible amphibious lifestyle.
Cemara's Family. After bankruptcy, Abah and Emak must adapt to a new life with their children in a remote village.
The Death of Stalin. The death of Russian dictator Joseph Stalin throws the Soviet Union into comic chaos as his ambitious but addled ministers maneuver to succeed him.
The Royal Hibiscus Hotel. A disenchanted chef tries to help her parents restore their failing hotel but cooks up feelings for an investor with his sights set on the property.
The Assignment. A hitman has his body surgically altered into a woman's against his will. Now he has to track down the surgeon responsible and get his revenge.
An Unfinished Life. A grieving widow and her daughter move in with her estranged father-in-law in Wyoming, where time allows them to heal and forgive.

titulo: My Entire High School Sinking Into the Sea
texto: My Entire High School Sinking Into the Sea. After an earthquake sends their school building drifting into the sea, a group of high-schoolers struggles to survive and overcome clique wars.
Concrete Football. The development of professional soccer worldwide owes a great debt to the soccer – or "football" – that is played on the streets of France.
The Pirates! Band of Misfits. An egotistical pirate captain strives to win the Pirate of the Year Award, but to snag the coveted prize, he'll have to outwit his dreaded rivals.
Sword of Trust. An offbeat foursome takes a wild journey through the Southern belt of denial to sell a relic purporting to prove the South won the Civil War.
YG Future Strategy Office. K-pop star Seungri, BIGBANG's youngest member, tries to lead a team of bumbling staff at YG's Future Strategy Office in this mockumentary sitcom.
5 Flights Up. A couple finds unexpected drama when, after 40 years of living in the same Brooklyn walk-up, they attempt to sell their apartment and buy a new one.
The Forest of Love. A con man and a would-be filmmaking crew force themselves into the lives of two grief-scarred young women. But nothing is as it seems.
Saaho. In a fictional megalopolis, a stunning underworld theft triggers a fierce power struggle among the gangsters, with an enigmatic cop on their trail.
Khan: No. 1 Crime Hunter. From fake marriages to online shopping fraud, a whip-smart police officer investigates truly baffling cons that were inspired by true stories.
Natsamrat - Asa Nat Hone Nahi. A veteran Shakespearean actor steps off the stage and into the painful tragedy of old age, facing ungrateful family and his fleeting legacy.
The Fosters. This offbeat drama charts the ups and downs of an interracial lesbian couple and their multiethnic brood of biological, adopted and foster children.
Chhota Bheem aur Krishna. Centuries after the end of a conqueror's rule, he is mysteriously back from the dead. It’s up to Bheem to save Dholakpur from being taken over!

titulo: Meet the Trumps: From Immigrant to President
texto: Meet the Trumps: From Immigrant to President. Learn about Donald Trump's family history, including his immigrant grandfather's gold-rush enterprises and his dad's development of a property empire.
Empire Games. Interviews with scholars and dramatic reenactments bring to life the origins and history-making achievements of the world's greatest ancient empires.
Maktub. After surviving a bomb attack, two low-level mobsters in Jerusalem change their ways and set about making strangers' Wailing Wall prayers come true.
Middle of Nowhere. After her husband is sent to prison for eight years, medical student Ruby shelves her studies to focus on her partner's welfare as he serves his time.
Yeh Meri Family. In the summer of 1998, middle child Harshu balances school, family, friendship and other challenges of growing up.
The Edge of Seventeen. A troubled teenager finds high school life even less bearable after she catches her childhood best friend hooking up with her popular older brother.
Mr. Woodcock. When a self-help author learns that his mother has fallen for his sadistic high school gym teacher, he tries to put a stop to their budding romance.

titulo: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
texto: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. When Indiana Jones is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.
Being AP. With retirement staring him in the face, an all-time-great jump jockey pursues his 20th consecutive title in his unrelenting quest for glory.
Vantage Point. Moments after he arrives in Spain for an antiterrorism summit, U.S. President Ashton is shot.

titulo: The Story of Us with Morgan Freeman
texto: The Story of Us with Morgan Freeman. Explore the forces of love, belief, power, war, peace, rebellion and freedom in this series about the ties that bind – and destroy – humanity.

titulo: Larry Charles' Dangerous World of Comedy
texto: Larry Charles' Dangerous World of Comedy. Legendary comedy writer and director Larry Charles travels the world in search of humor in the most unusual, unexpected and dangerous places.
Silvana Sin Lana. When her fugitive husband leaves her homeless and penniless, a once-wealthy woman has no other choice but to join the working class.
The Piano. With her daughter and her beloved piano in tow, a mute Scottish woman arrives in New Zealand, where a gruff loner sets out to seduce her.
Bareilly Ki Barfi. When she falls in love with the author of a novel she adores, bohemian Bitti enlists the help of a local printer to find her new object of affection.
Pardes. Prompted by loyalty, Arjun plays matchmaker between his philandering foster brother and a conservative girl but winds up falling in love himself.
Bad Boys II. In this hyperkinetic sequel, a pair of Miami narcotics cops investigate a Cuban drug kingpin's connection to Florida's influx of Ecstasy.
Genius. Extreme pressure from his father to excel at school during childhood has dangerous psychological effects on a brilliant but suicidal man’s adult life.

titulo: Norman Lear: Just Another Version of You
texto: Norman Lear: Just Another Version of You. This documentary turns the spotlight on the man behind the iconic "All in the Family," with comments from friends, family and famous collaborators.
Dilan 1991. Dilan's involvement in the motorbike gang imperils his relationship with Milea, whose distant relative returns from Belgium.
Houston, We Have a Problem!. Blending fact with myth, this conspiracy-minded docufiction argues that the U.S. purchased Yugoslavia's secret space program in the 1960s.
Addicted to Life. Chasing extreme challenges, athletic daredevils test their limits in various environments from giant waves to snowy slopes around the world.
Cinta Teruna Kimchi. When a young man determines to discover his father's true identity, he faces unexpected realizations that shake his sense of self.
20th Century Women. In 1979, single bohemian mom Dorothea, hoping to help her teen son find his place as a man, asks two young women to share their lives with him.
Welcome to Sudden Death. At a basketball game, an ex-Special Forces officer must face a group of tech-savvy hostiles when a team owner and his daughter are taken hostage.
Beyond Evil. As a killing resembling a cold case resurfaces in a small town, the chase for the truth falls on two policemen who each harbor secrets of their own.
Hormones. High school students in Bangkok wrestle with issues such as sex, teen pregnancy, drugs, school violence, family turmoil and more in this Thai drama.
Sisyphus. An unfathomable incident introduces a genius engineer to dangerous secrets of the world — and to a woman from the future who's come looking for him.
Kingpin. After a bowler loses his hand, his career takes a nosedive. That is, until he uncovers the next big thing: an Amish kid named Ishmael.
Union Leader. Toxic conditions and a corrupt union leader prompt a chemical plant worker and earnest family man to fight for justice for his fellow laborers.
The Legend of 420. This documentary explores the growing trend of marijuana decriminalization in the U.S. and the use of cannabis in medicine, art, fine dining and more.
Untold: Caitlyn Jenner. Caitlyn Jenner's unlikely path to Olympic glory was inspirational. But her more challenging road to embracing her true self proved even more meaningful.
Altered Carbon. After 250 years on ice, a prisoner returns to life in a new body with one chance to win his freedom: by solving a mind-bending murder.
Slow West. Determined to find the woman he loves, a Scottish teenager braves the Western frontier of 19th-century America, with bounty hunters hot on his trail.
Bright. In an LA rife with interspecies tensions, a human cop and his orc partner stumble on a powerful object and become embroiled in a prophesied turf war.
Niyazi Gül Dörtnala. Seeking the formula behind a magical elixir bequeathed to him by his father, a veterinary professor gets embroiled in a mobster's horse-racing scheme.

titulo: Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later
texto: Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later. A decade after their wild summer as junior counselors, the gang reunites for a weekend of bonding, hanky-panky and hair-raising adventures.
Who's the One. A doctor performs plastic surgery on a fat man who's been jilted, and continues his transformation by turning him into a handsome, desirable man.
Monarca. After 20 years, Ana María returns to Mexico and vies for control of her family's tequila empire as it threatens to crumble under corruption and secrets.
Fittest in Dubai. Top athletes from around the globe test their fitness in a four-day competition at the first-ever CrossFit Sanctional event. Let the games begin.
Man with a Plan. When his wife Andi returns to work, contractor Adam Burns becomes a stay-at-home dad and discovers that parenting is a tougher job than he realized.

titulo: The Last Man on the Moon
texto: The Last Man on the Moon. Astronaut Gene Cernan looks back on the exciting history of NASA's lunar landings and how being the last man to stand on the moon changed his life.
Gentlemen and Gangsters. Now on the run, a writer relates his previous year's escapades when he got sucked into the thrilling, sordid orbit of boxer and jazz man Henry Morgan.
Ana e Vitória. After meeting by chance, two young musicians with differing views on love and life record an album that drastically alters their lives.
Oh My Ghost 4. Ghosts wreak havoc at the old school, and a student communicates with the spirit while the team reckons with a power struggle.
Theo Who Lived. American journalist Theo Padnos retraces the Middle Eastern journey that led to his 2012 kidnapping and brutal torture by an al-Qaida faction.
Weapon of Choice. Speaking to retailers and owners of the Glock pistol, two filmmakers shed light on the politics of violence and its implications from Chicago to Kirkuk.
Eugenie Nights. In 1940s Port Said, Kariman finds comfort and solace in the arms of an unhappily married man, who also happens to be her abusive husband's brother.
Ha Unlimited. Three comedians launch a company designed to spread happiness far and wide in this Thai sitcom packed with gags, sound effects and special guests.

titulo: Nobody Speak: Trials of the Free Press
texto: Nobody Speak: Trials of the Free Press. Hulk Hogan's court case against Gawker Media sheds light on wealthy, powerful figures who challenge freedom of the press in order to silence critics.

titulo: Club Friday To Be Continued - Friend & Enemy
texto: Club Friday To Be Continued - Friend & Enemy. A love triangle spirals out of control, wreaking havoc on a couple's relationship and a friendship between two women.

titulo: Black Holes | The Edge of All We Know
texto: Black Holes | The Edge of All We Know. Follow scientists on their quest to understand and capture the first image of a black hole while exploring the limits of our knowledge of the universe.

titulo: Motu Patlu in the Game of Zones
texto: Motu Patlu in the Game of Zones. A board game becomes all too real for buddies Motu and Patlu when they get transported into its world of monsters, magic and mayhem.
Whisky. To impress family, a factory owner pretends to be married to one of his employees, and soon, the "couple" finds their lives radically altered.
Unriddle. When a hard-nosed detective reluctantly partners with an informant to solve complex cases, she uncovers links to a particularly puzzling cold case.
Lolita. In this black comedy, an English professor marries his landlady to get closer to his forbidden obsession: her teenage daughter.
Quigley Down Under. After traveling to Australia for a job, a sharpshooting cowboy becomes a target himself when he refuses an immoral assignment from a corrupt landowner.
Traffic Signal. Four characters coexist at an urban traffic signal, where all manage to make a meager living until events threaten the source of their livelihood.
On My Block. In a rough inner-city Los Angeles neighborhood, four smart, funny and streetwise teens find their lifelong friendship tested as they begin high school.
Huntik: Secrets and Seekers. A high school student searching for his missing father joins a secret group known as the Seekers, who ally with aliens to protect the world from evil.
Manglehorn. A reclusive small-town locksmith who can't stop writing letters to a lost love meets a kindly bank teller who challenges him to look to the future.
Urvi. After getting tricked into working at a brothel, a medical student joins forces with two of her co-workers to fight their unscrupulous exploiters.
The Fear of 13. After 20 years on Death Row, self-educated inmate Nick petitions the court to be executed, then tells his twisting, turning tale of despair and hope.
Zed Plus. A philandering small-town mechanic's political ambitions are sparked when the visiting prime minister mistakenly grants him special security clearance.
Chosen. When a mysterious box arrives at his door, a doctor and father is forced to participate in a twisted killing game, or risk losing everything.
2,215. This intimate documentary follows rock star Artiwara Kongmalai on his historic, 2,215-kilometer charity run across Thailand in 2017.
Krisha. After 10 years away from her family, Krisha returns for Thanksgiving, but bitter grudges and troubling addictions threaten to ruin the event.
Ninja Turtles: The Next Mutation. Everyone's favorite teenage mutants are back in live action to fight crime with help from a new ninja turtle – a female named Venus De Milo.
Black Sea. A hard-driving submarine captain is hired to steal gold from a sunken Nazi sub, but there's no honor among thieves during this underwater heist.
New York Minute. When bickering teenage twins accidentally land in the middle of a criminal operation, they'll have to work together to get themselves out of trouble.
Christine. In a film based on true events, an awkward but ambitious TV reporter struggles to adapt when she's ordered to focus on violent and salacious stories.
Power Rangers Ninja Storm. When the elite warriors from the Wind Ninja Academy are captured by the evil Lothor, Shane, Tori and Waldo become Wind Power Rangers to fight back.
The Whole Nine Yards. An unhappily married dentist becomes mixed up with mobsters and murder plots when he discovers that a notorious hit man has moved in next door.
Luis Miguel - The Series. This series dramatizes the life story of Mexican superstar singer Luis Miguel, who has captivated audiences in Latin America and beyond for decades.
Marseille. The longtime mayor of Marseille is preparing to hand over the reins to his protégé when a sudden and ruthless battle erupts for control of the city.
NATURE: Natural Born Hustlers. Sometimes being shady is the only way to survive, a fact these sneaky animal "hustlers" – including orcas, owls and otters – use to their advantage.
7 Days Out. Witness the excitement and drama behind the scenes in the seven days leading up to major live events in the worlds of sports, fashion, space and food.
Big Bad Beetleborgs. When three teens free a spirit that offers to grant each a wish, they choose to become their favorite superheroes, launching a series of adventures.
Nneka The Pretty Serpent. Years after the mysterious murder of her parents, a traumatized woman gains supernatural powers that aid in her quest for revenge against the killers.
Anitta: Made In Honório. In this intimate documentary, Brazilian pop queen Anitta opens up about fame, family and her fierce work ethic, revealing the woman behind the hits.
Hospital Playlist. Every day is extraordinary for five doctors and their patients inside a hospital, where birth, death and everything in between coexist.
Training Day. A rookie cop with one day to prove himself to a veteran LAPD narcotics officer receives a crash course in his mentor's questionable brand of justice.
The Creative Brain. Neuroscientist David Eagleman taps into the creative process of various innovators while exploring brain-bending, risk-taking ways to spark creativity.
Audrie & Daisy. In this wrenching documentary, two teens are sexually assaulted by boys they considered friends, humiliated online and harassed by their communities.
The Tuxedo. After a government spy is hospitalized, New York City cab driver Jimmy unwillingly takes over the spy's role – with the aid of a computerized tuxedo.
Gollu Aur Pappu. Hapless brothers Gollu and Pappu stumble into a terrorist plot and end up being ordered to detonate a bomb, a task they are destined to bungle.

titulo: Trailer Park Boys: Drunk, High and Unemployed: Live in Austin
texto: Trailer Park Boys: Drunk, High and Unemployed: Live in Austin. Ricky, Julian and Bubbles bring their trailer park humor out onto the stage for a night of bravado, schemes and an intoxicated acting demo.
Ugly. When a 10-year-old goes missing while her father, an actor, is out on an audition, the girl's stepfather – Mumbai's police chief – leads the search.
A Futile and Stupid Gesture. In a brief life full of triumph and failure, "National Lampoon" co-founder Doug Kenney built a comedy empire, molding pop culture in the 1970s.
Love Rhythms - Accidental Daddy. A successful DJ's bachelor lifestyle is upended by a young woman who claims to be his long lost daughter.
Sin senos sí hay paraíso. Born into a small town controlled by the mafia, an irate young woman seeks revenge on the forces that tore apart and wrongfully imprisoned her family.
Hating Peter Tatchell. This documentary follows gay rights activist Peter Tatchell from his early life to his fight for justice amid controversy and political turmoil.

The Death of Mr. Lazarescu. The plot of Romanian director Cristi Puiu's real-time drama is simple, following the travails of an ailing old man who waits for his illness to overtake him as a weary paramedic shuttles him between hospitals.

titulo: Brave Blue World: Racing to Solve Our Water Crisis
texto: Brave Blue World: Racing to Solve Our Water Crisis. From reuse to energy generation, new innovations across five continents are explored in this documentary about building a future for sustainable water.
Gold Statue. After tracing an artifact to his ancestry, a young man and his friend's search for a gilded statue lands them in a maximum-security prison.
The Croods. When an earthquake obliterates their cave, an unworldly prehistoric family is forced to journey through unfamiliar terrain in search of a new home.
Three-Quarters Decent. Determined to fight corruption in his country, a newspaper cartoonist debuts a new take-no-prisoners attitude.

titulo: An American Tail: The Treasures of Manhattan Island
texto: An American Tail: The Treasures of Manhattan Island. When Fievel and friends go hunting for buried treasure beneath the ruins of an old subway tunnel, they stumble onto something surprising.
Living with Yourself. Burned out on life, Miles undergoes a strange procedure at a strip mall spa – and wakes to find he's been replaced by a better version of himself.
Katha. Secretly in love with his neighbor, a mild-mannered clerk is heartbroken when his much bolder, more charming friend wins her heart instead.
Elizabeth at 90: A Family Tribute. A blend of the royal family's intimate recollections and rarely seen home movies pays tribute to Queen Elizabeth II on the eve of her 90th birthday.
Someone Has to Die. In conservative 1950s Spain, the alleged relationship between a young man and a Mexican ballerino creates an uproar of harrowing consequences.
Mango Dreams. Concerned that dementia will soon steal his most cherished memories, a Hindu doctor hires a Mulsim rickshaw driver to take him to his childhood home.
Jackpot. A lottery ticket salesperson faces an ethical dilemma after setting aside a soon-to-be winning ticket for a customer to pick up and pay for later.
Dushman. An Indian hotel waiter forms an unlikely bond with a Pakistani colleague when the establishment’s criminal owner threatens to ruin both their lives.
Spookley the Square Pumpkin. When a storm terrorizes his patch, a pumpkin cast out for his shape must step up to use his smarts to save the day – and to prove himself.
Kidnapping Stella. Snatched off the street and held for ransom, a bound and gagged woman uses her limited powers to derail her two masked abductors' carefully laid plans.
Recovery Boys. In a region ravaged by opioid abuse, four young men in a farming-based rehab forge a bond as they try to reinvent their lives after years of addiction.
Reality of Dream. Five friends from college chase their post-grad dreams of becoming a successful writer, film director, singer, rich wife and out-and-proud hair stylist.
The Protector. Discovering his ties to a secret ancient order, a young man living in modern Istanbul embarks on a quest to save the city from an immortal enemy.
Babylon Berlin. A Soviet freight train's hijacking leads a haunted cop and a poor typist to uncover a political conspiracy amid the vice and glamour of 1929 Berlin.
Takki. In Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, a young aspiring filmmaker and his circle of friends grapple with family expectations, gender roles, romance and rivalry.
Colkatay Columbus. When Christopher Columbus mysteriously appears in modern-day Kolkata, India, two struggling young men look to him for advice on achieving success.
Helios. When master criminal Helios steals a mobile WMD, rival agents from Hong Kong, South Korea and China must join forces to recover the device.
Underdogs. When his archenemy returns to settle a score, a foosball ace and his magically incarnated team must save the town and woo back his girl.
Prime Time. On New Year’s Eve 1999, an armed man enters a TV studio during a broadcast, takes the host hostage and makes one demand: to give a message live on air.
Burnistoun. This sketch series focuses on the eccentric characters in a small Scottish town, including bumbling cops, "DJ Jesus" and a disgruntled serial killer.
Rimba Racer. In this animated action series, a rookie driver seeks glory in a world-class auto race, but he’ll need more than just his talent behind the wheel.
Monty Python Best Bits (mostly). Prominent comedians pay tribute to Monty Python's best work in this five-part series, along with selected clips of sketches.
My Honor Was Loyalty. Amid the chaos and horror of World War II, a committed German soldier fights a private battle with his own conscience.
A Secret Love. Amid shifting times, two women kept their decades-long love a secret. But coming out later in life comes with its own set of challenges.
Booba: Food Puzzle. Curious Booba is now a chef! With friends Loola and Spike, he creates tasty treats with delightful designs using fruits, vegetables and other food.
Baby Mamas. From surprise news to relationship blues, four coworkers in different stages of motherhood unite to support each other in their struggles with men.
City of God. Growing up in a Rio de Janeiro slum, Rocket is able to avoid being drawn into a life of drugs and crime by having a passion for photography.
The Innocence Files. The Innocence Project unravels missteps and deceit in a series of wrongful convictions, exposing the injustice inflicted on victims and the accused.
Héroes. When an earthquake hits Chile, rescue workers must put aside their differences to save the country from a businessman's evil scheme.
Clash of the Titans. If he is to save the life of the beautiful Princess Andromeda, the valiant Perseus must battle a host of powerful, beastly enemies.
In Darkness. A blind pianist fears for her life after the suspicious death of her neighbor, the daughter of a businessman accused of war crimes.
Isa Pa with Feelings. When an aspiring architect falls for her Deaf neighbor, they develop a connection and set out to form their own love language despite their differences.
Fan of Amoory. Inspired by his idol Omar Abdulrahman, a young boy navigates obstacles as he chases his dream of becoming a professional soccer player.
The Lady in Dignity. The wife of a corporate heir finds her luxurious life overturned by a mysterious woman who joins the household as a caregiver for her father-in-law.
On My Skin. Arrested in Rome for a drug-related offense, Stefano Cucchi endures a harrowing week in custody that changes his family forever. Based on true events.
Signal. Communicating via a walkie-talkie that transcends time, a profiler from 2015 and a detective from 1989 join forces to tackle crimes and injustice.
This Little Love Of Mine. A workaholic lawyer returns to her island home to convince an old friend to take over his family’s company — but rekindled feelings soon get in the way.
Asura: The City of Madness. Caught between a corrupt mayor and a prosecutor intent on exposing political depravity, a police detective must decide whose side he's on.
Survivors Guide to Prison. Former inmates, officers and celebrities critique the U.S. prison system in this documentary packaged as a how-to handbook for the incarcerated.
Sarvopari Palakkaran. In the course of a human trafficking investigation, a conservative cop crosses paths with an artist-activist in a clash of worldviews.
The Other Guys. New York cops Allen and Terry toil in obscurity as lowly desk jockeys until a big break finally gives them a chance to tackle real police work.
Gimme Shelter. After running away from her abusive mother, a streetwise teen seeks refuge with her father, but he rejects her when he learns that she's pregnant.
Calico Critters. The adorable residents of Sylvanian Village always have lots of fun with their friends and families!
K-POP Extreme Survival. Seung Yeon decides to chase her dream of becoming a K-pop star and audition for a popular group. There's only one catch: It's a boy band.
The Royal House of Windsor. Drawing on newly available info, this show traces how the British royal family has survived the last 100 years of power struggles, politics and more.
Eyyvah Eyyvah 3. Life is tough for Hüseyin after marrying his true love. He works day and night to support his growing family, while singer Firuzan copes with fame.
Jab We Met. Changing fortunes await a wealthy but dejected industrialist when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.
Rukh. Following the untimely death of his father, a young man begins to reconnect with his family while uncovering some difficult truths.

titulo: The Fury of a Patient Man
texto: The Fury of a Patient Man. After his lover is killed in a jewelry store robbery, quiet José romances café owner Ana, who's unaware he has other motivations.
MeatEater. Steven Rinella scrounges in some of America's wildest terrains in this unscripted series showing him on the hunt for wild animals from ducks to deer.
Especial 20 años Fútbol de Primera. Revisit the emotional bouts and memorable highlights from the past two decades in this special celebrating esteemed TV show "Fútbol de Primera."
Secrets of Westminster. Take an insider's tour of Parliament, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey to discover the little-known history and pageantry of these famous buildings.

titulo: The Men Who Stare at Goats
texto: The Men Who Stare at Goats. A journalist latches onto an unbelievable story in Iraq when he meets Lyn, a man of mysterious origins who reveals he was a "warrior monk."
Astronomy Club: The Sketch Show. With unique individual perspectives that converge into a unified voice, sketch comedy group Astronomy Club delivers a smart and absurd brand of humor.
Monster High: Ghouls Rule. After learning that monsters and "Normies" used to spend Halloween together, Frankie Stein and her pals rally both groups for a frightfully good time.

titulo: Berlin, Berlin: Lolle on the Run
texto: Berlin, Berlin: Lolle on the Run. In this cinematic sequel to the hit TV series, Lolle has moved on from Sven and is about to marry her friend Hart – until Sven disrupts her plans.
Chitty Chitty Bang Bang. Quirky inventor Caractacus Potts and his family travel in their magical flying car to Vulgaria, a kingdom strangely devoid of children.
Crime Diaries: Night Out. After going to a Halloween party, college student Luis Andrés Colmenares is found dead. Was it an accident or murder? Inspired by true events.
Deranged. A substitute teacher and an obsessive student begin an illicit affair that endangers everyone involved and blurs the line between predator and prey.
Arctic Heart. Madly in love with a brilliant scientist studying an immunizing protein produced by penguins, a timid med student offers her body to his research.
Family Reunion. When the McKellan family moves from Seattle to small-town Georgia, life down South – and traditional grandparents – challenge their big-city ways.
MONKART. Jin and his dragon monster Draka set out on a racing adventure and try to save the kingdom from evil forces.
Hache. As Helena gains the love and trust of a dangerous heroin cartel leader in 1960s Barcelona, she hones the skills she needs to rise up the ranks.
Spivak. Struggling writer Wally Spivak is stuck in a rut – until he meets an engaged couple and starts to see life in a whole new way.
American Anarchist. This documentary profiles William Powell, who wrote the "The Anarchist Cookbook" in the early 1970s and spent his later life regretting his actions.
Jenny Slate: Stage Fright. Jenny Slate's first stand-up special is a mix of stage time, funny stories about adulthood and conversations with family in her childhood home.
Valentine's Day. The tripwires of modern love are exposed in a carousel involving relationships and the single life on the most romantic day of the year: February 14.
Kurt & Courtney. This film charts Nirvana's Kurt Cobain's rise to fame, his drug-addled romance with Courtney Love and the conspiracy theories surrounding his death.
Nocturnal Animals. Reading her ex-husband's violent novel manuscript destabilizes gallery owner Susan's life, upending her present while digging up their past.
Kate. Slipped a fatal poison on her final job, a ruthless assassin working in Tokyo has less than 24 hours to find out who ordered the hit and exact revenge.
Best Lover. Two young stars with different backgrounds and agendas enter into a fake marriage to advance their careers, until the fake starts turning real.
Seven Seconds. The death of a 15-year-old African American boy in Jersey City sets off a police cover-up and a search for the truth.
​​Kuch Bheege Alfaaz. After accidentally connecting over the Internet, two strangers form a tight friendship – not knowing they already share a bond.
Kara Bela. The uneventful life of middle-aged Kudret turns upside down when a road trip turns into a wild race for survival with killers in hot pursuit.
ReMastered: Devil at the Crossroads. Cloaked in mystery, bluesman Robert Johnson left his mark on American music. Now family, critics and famous fans look for the real man behind the music.

titulo: Elf Pets: A Fox Cub’s Christmas Tale
texto: Elf Pets: A Fox Cub’s Christmas Tale. An elite team of elves – and their furry fox cub friends – help bring the Christmas spirit to a boy whose mom may not make it home for the holidays.
My Only Love Song. When things don't go her way during a shooting for her new show, a top actress runs away in an old van that guides her on a time-traveling journey.

titulo: Monster Hunter: Legends of the Guild
texto: Monster Hunter: Legends of the Guild. In a world where humans and fearsome monsters live in an uneasy balance, young hunter Aiden fights to save his village from destruction by a dragon.
Dive Club. On the shores of Cape Mercy, a skillful group of teen divers investigate a series of secrets and signs after one of their own mysteriously goes missing.
Bachelor Girls. Through intimate interviews, this documentary explores the stigma facing independent women who seek housing in modern Mumbai.
Husbands in Goa. Three professional friends, all husbands living with domineering wives, take a well-deserved vacation in the resort city of Goa.
Jailbirds. At the Sacramento County Jail, incarcerated women fight the power and one another as they try to make the best of life – and love – on the inside.
The Little Mermaid. In this take on the classic tale, a captive circus mermaid transforms the lives of a skeptical journalist and his wide-eyed young sister.
Liar, Liar, Vampire. When a shy teen transfers to a new school, he elects to mix things up by playing along with the rumor that he's a vampire.
The Sunshine Makers. Take a trip and witness the rise and fall of Tim Scully and Nicholas Sand, improbable pioneers of the drug counterculture during the 1960s.
Rocky Handsome. A reclusive pawn shop owner sets his sights on revenge when vicious gangsters kidnap his drug-addicted neighbor's young daughter.
Skylines. When a mysterious alien virus begins to endanger humanity, an elite team of soldiers launches into space to end the threat for good.
John Mellencamp: Plain Spoken. Iconic rocker John Mellencamp lights up Chicago in an electrifying live performance featuring old classics and new tracks.
Water & Power: A California Heist. California residents and farmers face powerful barons in the struggle to secure water rights in this fresh historical account of profit and interests.
Pop, Lock 'n Roll. An ambitious hip-hop dancer jeopardizes his rising career when his affections for an ominous producer's wife threatens to stomp out all of his success.
Lust Stories. In the companion to 2013's "Bombay Talkies," four short films by four of India's biggest directors explore love, sex and relationships in modern India.

titulo: Melodies of Life - Born This Way
texto: Melodies of Life - Born This Way. A celebrated pastry chef and his fellow staff members at a bake shop embark on bittersweet adventures in love, work and friendship.
Thug Life. A get-rich-quick scheme goes awry when a group of friends stumbles onto a dangerous conspiracy and wind up getting mistaken for the bad guys.
The Trial of the Chicago 7. What was supposed to be a peaceful protest turned into a violent clash with the police. What followed was one of the most notorious trials in history.
By the Sea. Troubled by the state of their marriage, Vanessa and Roland visit a French seaside town, where they have a fateful encounter with a pair of newlyweds.
Liar's Dice. A woman from a small mountain village disobeys her village elders and sets out for the big city in search of her missing husband.
Virgin River. Searching for a fresh start, a nurse practitioner moves from LA to a remote northern California town and is surprised by what – and who – she finds.
Wadi. After the death of his father, a passive and good-natured teenager named Wadi struggles with family, work and love.
The Pyramid Code. How was the scientific understanding of the ancients so advanced? A team of experts answers this and other questions in this fascinating series.
Tarzan. After being shipwrecked off the African coast, a lone child grows up in the wild, and is destined to become lord of the jungle.
Dance Academy. Fifteen-year-old Tara Webster's dream of dancing comes true when she gets into a top dance academy. She soon realizes dancing is only half the battle.
The Land of Cards. A royal prince arrives on an island of fascist rule and inspires a rebellion among its women in this hallucinogenic adaptation of a classic play.
Arjun: The Warrior Prince. This animated retelling of the classic Indian tale of Prince Arjun – part of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata – begins during the prince's youth.
Marriage Palace. After a young man charms the girl he loves into accepting his proposal, an accidental swap on their wedding day leads him to marry the wrong bride.
Sotus The Series. When freshman engineering student Kongpob stands up to older bully Arthit, their confrontation soon leads to a deep attraction between the two boys.
Forks Over Knives. According to the research of two food scientists, the popularity of processed foods has led to epidemic rates of obesity, diabetes and other diseases.
Oththa Seruppu Size 7. Taken into custody, a murder suspect's theatrical explanations of his peculiar modus operandi unearth truths far beyond the crime he’s accused of.
Tragic Jungle. To escape an arranged marriage, a woman flees into the depths of the Mayan jungle, where untamed nature merges the human and the supernatural.
Ophelia. In this retelling of “Hamlet” from Ophelia’s point of view, the lady-in-waiting’s shared love with Denmark’s prince is ruined by treachery and madness.
37 Seconds. Trapped by society and familial obligations, a young manga artist goes on an unconventional journey for sexual freedom and personal liberation.
Pup Star: World Tour. Talented pooches from around the world compete to be the next Pup Star, but behind-the-scenes schemes threaten to ruin the fun.
A Private War. In this biopic, war correspondent Marie Colvin risks it all to bring back the truth from the frontlines, despite the toll it takes on her own life.
Special. A young gay man with cerebral palsy branches out from his insular existence in hopes of finally going after the life he wants.
Magnolia. Through chance, history and divine intervention, a cast of eclectic characters weaves and warps through each other's lives on a random day in California.
Sleepless. A Las Vegas cop attempts to rob a drug shipment from a casino kingpin, but the heist goes horribly wrong, leading to the kidnapping of his son.
Mahi NRI. A Punjabi man attempts to build a life in London in hopes of impressing his girlfriend’s mother, who insists her daughter marry a man outside of India.
Ayana. With his carefree bachelor days behind him, a young entrepreneur’s ambitions for adulthood come with some painful personal and professional decisions.
Junebug. When a big-city art dealer travels to North Carolina to meet her new husband's small-town family, their trip gives rise to a multitude of problems.
Baahubali 2: The Conclusion (Tamil Version). To avenge his father's death, a young man leads an army into battle against a cruel tyrant in this Tamil conclusion to the historic saga.
Odu Raja Odu. While trying to buy his wife a set-top box, a struggling writer and his pal get entangled in the domino effect of a spectacularly botched drug deal.
Silver Linings Playbook. A man with bipolar disorder moves home with his parents and makes a connection with a spirited widow, which helps both of them heal in unique ways.
Surviving R. Kelly. In this documentary series on the tangled history of allegations against musician R. Kelly, women give detailed accounts of sexual and mental abuse.
Who Am I. After his compatriots are murdered by Russian gangsters, a hacker confesses the history of his elite, fame-seeking group to a Europol investigator.
Ordinary People. Barely making a living as pickpockets, a teenage couple in Manila resort to desperate measures when their one-month-old child is kidnapped.
Bhaji In Problem. Married to two women – each unaware of the other – a man finds his double life threatened when an old friend who knows his not-so-little secret arrives.
K.O. One Re-act. As a guardian of space-time order, 28-year-old Wang Dadong returns to Bale High School to investigate an anomaly and clashes with King.
The Social Dilemma. This documentary-drama hybrid explores the dangerous human impact of social networking, with tech experts sounding the alarm on their own creations.

titulo: Judy Moody and the Not Bummer Summer
texto: Judy Moody and the Not Bummer Summer. In this family film, never-dull third-grader Judy Moody embarks on a summer adventure with her brother, Stink, and always-up-for-fun Aunt Opal.
Offspring. A Melbourne obstetrician in her thirties struggles with the increasingly chaotic family, romantic and professional aspects of her life in this drama.
Khalnayak. A prison guard goes undercover as a dancer to try and recapture an escaped criminal and restore her police inspector boyfriend's reputation.
Spice Up. A spoiled young woman steps in to save her family’s restaurant with her cooking and tasting skills while balancing her complicated love life.
The Eddy. The owner of a Paris jazz club gets tangled up with dangerous criminals as he fights to protect his business, his band and his teenage daughter.
Buddies. Inspired by the movie "Thelma & Louise," three young people with Down syndrome leave the institution where they live to take a road trip together.
Countdown: Inspiration4 Mission to Space. From training to launch to landing, this all-access docuseries rides along with the Inspiration4 crew on the first all-civilian orbital space mission.
Bethany Hamilton: Unstoppable. This documentary follows the rising tide of Bethany Hamilton who lost her arm as a teen before making waves in pro surfing and her personal life.
A Princess for Christmas. At the invitation of a relative, young Jules Daly travels with her niece and nephew to a castle in Europe, where Jules falls for a dashing prince.
Rishta.com. Partners at an Indian matrimonial agency face endlessly challenging and often impossible demands as they help clients make the perfect match.
Don 2. With Asia under his complete control, criminal mastermind Don turns to Europe, battling the mob bosses of each nation along the way.
30 Days of Luxury. With the help of his friends, a man breaks out of prison in hopes of restoring a lively nightclub.
Dealer. Tensions erupt when two filmmakers infiltrate an area ruled by gangs to shoot a music video for a rapper in this gritty found-footage series.
7 Din Mohabbat In. Given just seven days by a genie to find a girl who will fall for him, a nerdy young man embarks on a madcap and messy search for his would-be wife.
Chal Dhar Pakad. After her fat-shaming husband brings home a new lover, a wife in Maharashtra recruits a group of women to challenge him in a kabaddi match.
I Am Divine. This captivating documentary explores the life and work of filmmaker John Waters's muse: internationally celebrated drag superstar Divine.
Love Is in the Air. Toprak, who lost her baby, is hired as a wet nurse for wealthy Yusuf's motherless son. Yusuf is drawn to Toprak, but also to her scheming sister.
Creating The Queen's Gambit. A fascinating character. Exquisite sets. A wig for every era. The stars, creators and crew reveal how the hit series about a chess prodigy came to life.
My Horrible Grandma. As a man fumbles to keep things in order, his assertive grandmother tries to straighten out his life when she returns to live with him.
Lupin. Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.
Skyline. After a wild night of partying, Terry discovers that he's one of the few people left on Earth, then sets out to solve the mystery of what happened.
Hap and Leonard. In late-1980s Texas, two best friends get involved in darkly comic misadventures by hiring themselves out to shady clients for illicit ends.

titulo: A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding
texto: A Christmas Prince: The Royal Wedding. A year after helping Richard secure the crown, Amber returns to Aldovia to plan their wedding. But her simple tastes clash with royal protocol.
Nimbe. A bullied teenager gravitates toward the acceptance he finds in a street gang but soon ends up involved in a world of drug abuse and organized crime.
Captain Underpants Mega Blissmas. Christmas gets weird — really weird — after George and Harold go back in time to change up a few of their beloved holiday's traditions.
Joy. Close to paying off her debts, a Nigerian sex worker in Austria coaches a reluctant novice, and assesses the risks of taking a faster path to freedom.

titulo: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
texto: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King. Aragorn is revealed as the heir to the ancient kings as he, Gandalf and the other members of the broken fellowship struggle to save Gondor.

titulo: Sleepless Society: Two Pillows & A Lost Soul
texto: Sleepless Society: Two Pillows & A Lost Soul. A motivational speaker about to divorce her abusive husband wakes up from a wild party one morning to find a dead body.
Girlfriends' Guide to Divorce. After the world learns the truth about her failing marriage, a successful self-help author tries to salvage her career and find her way as a divorcée.
Dueños del paraíso. When Anastasia Cardona's drug lord husband is murdered, she inherits his cocaine empire, leading to a life of wealth, power, violence and betrayal.
Great News. A TV news producer's ambitions take an awkward turn when her mother rejoins the workforce and snags a job as the station's newest intern.
Julie and the Phantoms. Julie lost her passion for music when she lost her mom. But when three ghostly guys appear and lift her spirits, they decide to start a band together!
Tottaa Pataaka Item Maal. Exasperated with living in perpetual fear for their safety, four women kidnap a man to show him the realities of being female in Delhi.
Kill Bill: Vol. 1. An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle. But she lives – and plots her vengeance.
Hati Perempuan. Sparks of both passion and contempt fly when a self-sufficient architect is forced to work with a snobbish industrialist.
Bittersweet. After 20 years abroad, a photographer returns to his birth country of Egypt and gets stranded without identification in a now unfamiliar culture.

titulo: John of God: The Crimes of a Spiritual Healer
texto: John of God: The Crimes of a Spiritual Healer. Idolized medium João Teixeira de Faria rises to international fame before horrifying abuse is revealed by survivors, prosecutors and the press.
Finding ‘Ohana. In Oʻahu for the summer, two siblings from Brooklyn connect with their Hawaiian heritage — and their family — on a daring quest for long-lost treasure.
American Son. Time passes and tension mounts in a Florida police station as an estranged interracial couple awaits news of their missing teenage son.
Peter Rabbit. In this mix of live action and CGI, rascally Peter Rabbit faces a tough new foe in his ongoing battle for the veggies in Mr. McGregor's garden.
The Sweetest Thing. After meeting her potential soul mate, a commitment-averse young woman hits the road with her best friend on a wild, raunchy misadventure to find him.
Miniforce. Four animal superheroes called the Miniforce transform into robots to protect small and defenseless creatures from the hands of scheming villains.
Alakada Reloaded. To cope with her feelings of inferiority, a woman from an impoverished family tells tall tales of her wealth and influence to upgrade her social status.
Singularity. Nearly a century after artificial intelligence tried to eradicate people from Earth, two survivors search for a human enclave rumored to still exist.
Shakti: The Power. A young mother must break free of the clutches of her husband's feudal family and bring herself and her young child to safety.
Love Cheque Charge. Three years after making a wild promise to a woman in distress, a rigid businessman runs into her again and must decide whether to honor his word.
The Married Couples. Hailing from different classes, a young man and his wife try to find their version of happily married when both yearn to leave their old lives behind.
Good Night, and Good Luck. Veteran television newsman Edward R. Murrow faces off against Sen. Joseph McCarthy and his crusade to quell the threat of communism in America.
Sweet Tooth. On a perilous adventure across a post-apocalyptic world, a lovable boy who's half-human and half-deer searches for a new beginning with a gruff protector.
Radiopetti. An elderly, hearing-impaired Indian man stays connected to the world of the past through the beloved valve radio he has owned since childhood.
Fishpeople. In this exploration of the life-changing power of the ocean, six people from very different backgrounds find purpose and meaning in the sea.
Traitors. As World War II ends, a young English woman agrees to help an enigmatic American agent root out Russian infiltration of the British government.
Porto. In a coastal Portuguese city, an erotic encounter ensues between an American expat and a French student, resonating through their lives years later.
Cold Mountain. This drama follows a wounded Civil War soldier making the long journey home, while his faraway love fights for survival on her deceased father's farm.
The Great Heist. In 1994, a team of thieves plans an ambitious heist to steal millions from Colombia's Bank of the Republic. Inspired by true events.
Eternal Love. After the deities Bai Qian and Ye Hua meet and fall in love, their romance stands the test of three lifetimes — each an epic in its own right.
Mountain. Featuring breathtaking imagery and thought-provoking narration, this film takes viewers to the summits of some of the world’s most amazing mountains.
Roped. A star cowboy in a traveling rodeo gets thrown off course when he falls in love with the daughter of a tough-minded town councilman.
The Last Face. Savage civil war and a dispute over humanitarian assistance threaten to unravel a checkered romance between an aid director and a doctor.
Pimpal. As a lonely widower prepares to leave India to live with his children in America, he looks back on past memories and unfinished business.
Janoskians: Untold and Untrue. Follow the story of three Australian brothers and their two friends who became an international sensation by posting pranks and gags on YouTube.
Queen of the Desert. Driven beyond the bounds of convention, adventurer Gertrude Bell leaves turn-of-the-century Britain behind for the deserts of the Middle East.
Accident. A contract killer skilled at staging lethal accidents fears he may be a victim of his own strategy when an accomplice dies in a mysterious mishap.
This Evening. The lives of a wealthy couple hiding their marital problems intersect with a group of hackers and the young women they exploit.
The App. While in Rome to shoot his first movie, actor and industrial heir Nick becomes obsessed with a dating app that sends him into a self-destructive spiral.
Stories by Rabindranath Tagore. The writings of Nobel Prize winner Rabindranath Tagore come to life in this collection of tales set in early-20th-century Bengal.
Penelope. In this modern fairy tale, a young woman cursed with the nose of a pig lives her life in seclusion – until an unlikely beau stumbles onto the scene.
Pareeth Pandaari. As the parents of three unmarried daughters, a humble cook and his wife contend with the challenges of matchmaking and social expectations.
Jatts in Golmaal. Without fully realizing the consequences, a boy who wants to relocate from India to Canada sells his heart to a gangster in need of a transplant.

titulo: Dragons: Dawn of the Dragon Racers
texto: Dragons: Dawn of the Dragon Racers. The "How to Train Your Dragon" adventure continues when a hunt for lost sheep turns into a fierce, fun-filled competition.
Blue Valentine. As Cindy and Dean muddle through their languishing marriage, they hearken back to the golden days when life was filled with possibility and romance.
Sniper: Legacy. When a troubled sniper begins killing officers he blames for a bungled mission, elite marksman Brandon Beckett sets out to neutralize the threat.
Penalty Kick. Convinced Mexico will lose the World Cup qualifier without him, a soccer superfan faces an impossible choice when family obligations stand in his way.
Table Manners. When a housewife's picture-perfect life comes crashing down, she finds solace and hope through cooking, family and love.
Surviving Death. What happens after we die? This docuseries explores personal stories and research on near-death experiences, reincarnation and paranormal phenomena.
Beynelmilel. When a local musician and his band are forced to perform in honor of a right-wing coup, his daughter schemes to make their music subversive instead.
Fitoor. A young artist falls for an aristocratic young woman whose bitter mother has trained her in the art of breaking hearts.
Always a Bridesmaid. Never married but always at weddings, a copy editor finally dives into the dating pool but wonders if her love story involves staying single forever.
Locked Up. Manipulated into embezzling funds for her boyfriend and sentenced to prison, a naïve young woman must quickly learn to survive in a harsh new world.
Your Excellency. Bumbling through politics, a billionaire businessman's presidential campaign seems destined for disaster until it gets a boost from social media.
Case. A smart lawyer whose drinking and recklessness send him on a path of self-destruction finds new purpose investigating a teenager's apparent suicide.
Game. A tycoon accuses three strangers of killing his daughter but mysteriously dies before he can expose them, sparking a tangled hunt for the real culprit.
Freaks – You're One of Us. Tipped by a mysterious tramp, a meek fry cook discovers she has superpowers — and kindred spirits — and uncovers an unsavory, widespread conspiracy.
Heart & Soul. At a hospital in Lagos, a doctor yearning for more field experience meets patients with various ailments that test his spiritual and medical beliefs.
Encerrados. This fictional series tells the stories of what happens to people when they feel caged in, whether physically, psychologically or emotionally.
Back to School. Eager to flaunt their success in front of old bullies and teenage crushes, two best friends spend a wild night at their middle school reunion.
The Universe. Discover the secrets of the universe in this series that pairs animation with insights on distant planets, black holes and other celestial marvels.
Life as We Know It. Holly and Eric discover reciprocal hatred during their first date, but must put their feelings aside after becoming guardians of their friends' baby.
Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway. After Char’s rebellion, Hathaway Noa leads an insurgency against Earth Federation, but meeting an enemy officer and a mysterious woman alters his fate.
The Wedding Guest. Hired to extract a bride-to-be before her arranged wedding in Pakistan, a hired gun goes on the run with his hostage when his plan unravels.

titulo: Lego Friends: Girls on a Mission
texto: Lego Friends: Girls on a Mission. Five best friends put their teamwork, wits and courage to the test when they take on a mission to protect Heartlake City from bad people.
Millennials. A group of millennials copes with the pressures of adulting by tackling a diverse set of problems from unemployment to cheating.
Desperados. After drunkenly sending a cringeworthy email, hopeless romantic Wes heads to Mexico with her best friends to erase the note before her new love reads it.
Anchor and Hope. Kat and Eva’s happy romance hits a rough patch when Eva decides that she wants a child. Visiting friend Roger could help complete their family.
HOMECOMING: A film by Beyoncé. This intimate, in-depth look at Beyoncé's celebrated 2018 Coachella performance reveals the emotional road from creative concept to cultural movement.
Skydancers. Only a few women pilots take part in the sport of aerobatics. Director Fredric Lean captures their powerful spirit at the World Aerobatic Championships.
I Am Maris. Through her own words and art, a young woman details the healing power of yoga in her struggle with anorexia and her journey to self-acceptance.
Figures of Speech. In this documentary, passionate high schoolers travel the country and come of age during a turbulent yearlong prep for a national speech competition.
American Crime. This anthology series unfolds a different story arc for each season, with dramas focusing on aspects of American life and the criminal justice system.

titulo: Luccas Neto in: The End of Christmas
texto: Luccas Neto in: The End of Christmas. To save Christmas, Luccas and Gi head to the North Pole and are recruited by Santa Claus to find all the gifts that have mysteriously disappeared.
Tribhanga - Tedhi Medhi Crazy. When her estranged mother falls into a coma, a self-made single mom grapples with regret and resentment while reflecting on their strained relationship.
44 Cats. Paw-esome tales abound when singing furry friends Lampo, Milady, Pilou and Meatball band together.
NOVA: Killer Floods. Scientists search for evidence left behind by the world’s greatest floods and predict if climate change will cause even greater aquatic disasters.
Seoul Searching. Teens of Korean descent who were born and raised in other countries travel to Seoul to learn about their cultural heritage at a summer camp in 1986.
The Da Vinci Code. When the curator of the Louvre is killed, a Harvard professor and a cryptographer must untangle a web of deceit involving works of Leonardo da Vinci.
A Serious Man. With every aspect of his life unraveling, a Jewish physics professor seeks out three rabbis for spiritual guidance.
I Am Vengeance: Retaliation. To clear his criminal record, an ex-special forces soldier agrees to lead a team to retrieve a double-crossing mercenary and deliver him to justice.
Operator. When a programmer uses his wife's sympathetic voice for his company's customer service app, he starts to rely more on her idealized self than her.
Shanghai. Three disparate characters uncover government corruption as a small Indian town receives an influx of foreign money to turn it into the next Shanghai.
VS.. A young man in foster care finds his voice in the underground rap battle scene. But when his mother returns, a lifetime of pain comes with her.
Atomic Puppet. Captain Atomic – once a superhero, now a sock puppet – can only activate his powers with the help of Joey, his new partner and biggest fan.

titulo: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
texto: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas. Yabba-dabba-doo! Digital dinosaurs rule the day when Fred, Barney, Betty and Wilma take Vegas by storm in this prequel that posits their lives before marriage.
The Flying Guillotine. In Qing-dynasty China, the emperor commands that a weapon be invented to kill at a distance without a trace. Then he orders it used on its wielders.
Leyla Everlasting. A resilient housewife, her husband and their marriage therapist become mired in a toxic love triangle and a plot to obtain an antique manuscript.
Legally Blonde. When dazzling L.A. sorority girl Elle Woods gets dumped by her snobby boyfriend, she decides to win him back by following him to Harvard Law School.
House of Z. Featuring archival footage and exclusive interviews, this documentary looks at the rise, fall and comeback of charismatic fashion designer Zac Posen.
Angel Has Fallen. Secret Service agent Mike Banning is caught in the crossfire when he’s framed for a deadly attack on the president and forced to run for his life.
Manhunt. A Chinese pharmaceutical lawyer framed for a vile crime teams up with a sharp-witted Japanese detective to stop a dangerous corporate plot.
Harry Benson: Shoot First. This film chronicles the career of photographer Harry Benson, who earned global renown with his candid shots of the Beatles and other celebrities.
Race. The plot thickens around two horse-racing competitors when three beautiful women come into their lives and a murder is committed.
Dirty Money. From crippling payday loans to cars that cheat emissions tests, this investigative series exposes brazen acts of corporate greed and corruption.
Tughlaq Durbar. A budding politician has devious plans to rise in the ranks — until an unexpected new presence begins to interfere with his every crooked move.
Convict. Sentenced to death for committing rape, a convict navigates his final trying days alongside his allies and enemies in prison.
El último testigo. A security expert and ex-CIA agent living in Belgium must go on the run with his estranged teen daughter when they're both marked for assassination.
Rize. This documentary explores "krumping," a fast-paced urban dance, and follows the man that originated the phenomenon in South Central Los Angeles.
Pocoyo. Discovery is the name of the game for friendly toddler Pocoyo in this lifelike and richly colored animated adventure series for preschoolers.
Generation Iron 2. New-generation bodybuilding stars – including Rich Piana, Kai Greene and Calum von Moger – share their experiences competing in the demanding sport.
Hot Rod. Andy Samberg stars in this comedy as an accident-prone daredevil who's determined to jump 15 buses on his moped and impress his abusive stepfather.
The Hummingbird Project. After discovering a shortcut that gives them a technological advantage, two cousins look to earn their big score by outracing a massive corporation.
Twelve Forever. Reggie's wild imagination unlocks a weird and wonderful world where she can be herself – and escape the pressures of growing up.
Rhyme & Reason. The world and culture of rap song topics such as race, violence, police, family and sex are examined by hip-hop performers from both coasts.
The Crying Game. IRA terrorist Fergus bonds with his prisoner, Jody. Jody tells Fergus of his girlfriend, Dil, with whom Fergus later falls in love.
The Beach Loafer. A wedding singer and his friends try to prove his innocence after he's accused of murder, a situation threatening his own marriage plans.
Solo: A Star Wars Story. A young Han Solo tries to settle an old score with the help of his new buddy Chewbacca, a crew of space smugglers and a cunning old friend.
Community. When his degree is found bogus, lawyer Jeff Winger is sent back to college, where he meets students and teachers with credentials as dubious as his.
Happyish. A middle-aged adman is shaken up by his new boss, a 25-year-old who advises him to "rebrand" himself. Is it possible, or is this as good as he'll get?
One Day. When his colleague (and crush) temporarily loses her memory, an overlooked geek seizes the chance to make an impression before she remembers again.
Goldie. When a bold teen mounts a gritty pursuit to dance in a music video, she must also evade child services so she can keep her younger sisters together.
Better Than Us. A family on the brink of splitting up become the owners of a cutting-edge robot being sought by a corporation, homicide investigators and terrorists.
PJ Masks. Three 6-year-old kids who live normal lives during the day become superheroes at night, fighting crime as a team known as PJ Masks.
Love, Rosie. Over the years, as they come and go in each other's life, childhood pals Rosie and Alex struggle to resolve the lasting, intimate bond between them.
The Game Changers. Special Forces trainer James Wilks asks elite athletes to compare the merits of meat, protein and plants for building strength. Spoiler: plants win.
Message from the King. On a relentless quest to avenge his sister's murder, a man from Cape Town infiltrates a sprawling network of lowlifes and elites in Los Angeles.
BNK48: Girls Don't Cry. Members of the Thai idol girl group BNK48 open up about their experiences beyond the spotlight, their training and the nature of fame.
Okupas. In 2000, a group of young men takes over a house in Buenos Aires, becoming squatters, while dealing with an increasingly violent and hostile city.
Trial 4. Charged as a teen in the 1993 killing of a Boston cop, Sean K. Ellis fights to prove his innocence while exposing police corruption and systemic racism.
Paint It Black. In the wake of a young artist’s suicide, his pianist mother and his despairing girlfriend square off in a living nightmare beset by guilt and blame.
An Easy Girl. A teen girl is drawn to her cousin’s hedonistic lifestyle when they spend the summer together in Cannes as she learns about herself and her own values.
The Russian Revolution. Starting in 1881, this film describes how the personal battle between the royal Romanovs and Lenin's Ulyanov family led to the Russian Revolution.
Filmworker. Leon Vitali had a thriving acting career most others would envy. Then he gave it all up to devote himself completely to the vision of Stanley Kubrick.
Sugar High. Talented sugar artists compete for $10,000 over two rounds of competition — candy and sugar sculpture — in this "Sugar Rush" spinoff special.
Stranger than Fiction. As a writer ponders how to kill off her main character, the man begins hearing her voice in his head and realizes that his days are numbered.
Vizontele. In 1974, a rural town in Anatolia gets its first television set – an event that's met with both excitement and trepidation by the villagers.
GO! The Unforgettable Party. Mía's vacation with her dad is disrupted by the surprise arrival of Lupe, Mercedes, Juanma and Álvaro as their school drama moves lakeside.
Tanda Tanya. In a story of interconnected lives, three families of different religious faiths navigate conflicting beliefs, hardships and other struggles.
I Heart Arlo. It's a whole new world for Arlo and his one-of-a kind pals when they set out to restore a run-down New York City neighborhood — and make it their own.
Dinotrux Supercharged. Amped up with powers that make them faster, stronger and more agile than ever, the Dinotrux are back to face new challenges and meet new friends.

titulo: Elite Short Stories: Guzmán Caye Rebe
texto: Elite Short Stories: Guzmán Caye Rebe. Rebe hosts an intimate house warming party for her friends, but the situation takes a dramatic turn with the help of drugs and unexpected visitors.
Avatar: The Last Airbender. Siblings Katara and Sokka wake young Aang from a long hibernation and learn he's an Avatar, whose air-bending powers can defeat the evil Fire Nation.
Weeds on Fire. In 1980s Hong Kong, a school principal forms a baseball team with an eclectic crew of local students who soon fight their way to the top of the league.
Octonauts: Above & Beyond. The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea — and onto land! With new rides and new friends, they'll protect any habitats and animals at risk.
Father of the Year. A drunken debate between two recent college grads about whose father would win in a fight leads to mayhem when their dads take the challenge seriously.
Last Chance U: Basketball. “Last Chance U” hits the hardwood in East Los Angeles as a coach with strong convictions leads young men who hope to fulfill major college potential.
최강전사 미니특공대 : 영웅의 탄생. Miniforce, a special task force of elite rangers, takes on the Lizard Army to save Earth before it’s too late, in this prequel to the TV series.
The Lincoln Lawyer. A street-wise defense lawyer who operates out of the back seat of his Lincoln lands a high-profile case that soon puts him and his family in danger.
The Next Karate Kid. In Boston, karate master Mr. Miyagi finds a new pupil in troubled teen Julie Pierce when she gets bullied by a group of relentless classmates.
Five Feet Apart. A teen with cystic fibrosis shakes up her daily routine and challenges hospital protocol when she falls for a fellow patient.
True: Rainbow Rescue. True and Bartleby travel to the other side of the Neverending Rainbow to bring back Dillydally — a brave explorer who's the Rainbow King's best friend!
21 Thunder. Players and coaches for a Montreal soccer team chase dreams of stardom while their personal lives erupt with love, fear, passion and violence.
Love.com. When a fashion blogger falls for a video game vlogger, their romance goes viral. But separating their virtual life from reality gets complicated.
INDIA. A man buys a young girl, code-names her "Doll" and sends her to live with a mother of two who has a mysterious mission to be fulfilled.
Transformers Rescue Bots Academy. As part of the first class at the Rescue Bots Academy, five Cybertron recruits train under their skilled teachers and take on daring rescue missions.
Atlas Shrugged: Part II. With the world's economy in dire straits, corporate protagonist Dagny Taggart searches for a solution amid the rubble of a long-abandoned factory.
League of Legends Origins. Fans, experts and creators of the "League of Legends" detail the game’s rise from free demo to global esports titan.
Love Me or Leave Me. When a marriage-phobic woman hires a seductress to test how faithful her eager-to-wed boyfriend is, her plan takes an unexpected turn.
Under an Arctic Sky. Six fearless surfers travel to the north coast of Iceland to ride waves unlike anything they've ever experienced, captured with high-tech cameras.

titulo: Barbie Dreamhouse Adventures: Go Team Roberts
texto: Barbie Dreamhouse Adventures: Go Team Roberts. As the Roberts family heads to Costa Rica to investigate a mermaid legend, Barbie takes on a summer job at a water park run by a devious boss.
13 Reasons Why. After a teenage girl's perplexing suicide, a classmate receives a series of tapes that unravel the mystery of her tragic choice.
Ezel. A young man framed for a crime escapes a prison sentence by faking his own death and assuming a new identity as he seeks revenge.
High End Yaariyan. From romantic pursuits to their friendship, a trio of young men navigate the complexities of relationships while sharing a London apartment.
Hantu Kak Limah. When Kak Limah turns up dead shortly after her marriage to a much younger man, her pesky ghost haunts the villagers, who can't seem to get rid of her.
Soekarno. This biographical drama about Indonesia's first president recounts his nationalist crusade to seize independence from Dutch colonial rule.

titulo: Lo más sencillo es complicarlo todo
texto: Lo más sencillo es complicarlo todo. When a 17-year-old learns the TV news host she pines for is engaged, she and her best friend launch an elaborate plan to prevent his marriage.
Jeremy Scott: The People's Designer. The journey of fashion designer Jeremy Scott from humble roots on a Missouri farm to creative director of Moschino is charted in this documentary.
Budapest. Two best friends put their careers and marriages on the line when they launch a business hosting outrageous, anything-goes bachelor parties in Hungary.
Bright Star. This drama details the passionate three-year romance between Romantic poet John Keats – who died tragically at age 25 – and his great love and muse.
Wedding Unplanned. Mathias's girlfriend finds a business card for a wedding planner in his pocket. Suddenly, he's engaged and hiring his lover to plan the big day!
Layer Cake. A suave, steely-eyed London cocaine dealer's retirement plans hit a violent snag when his boss asks him to do one more job.
Tellur Aliens. Three teenaged best friends on the planet Telluria begin an incredible journey of adventure as they fight against the most evil being in the universe.
Charlie's Angels. A tight-knit trio of specially trained agents wield weapons — and charm — as they track down stolen software in this reboot of the classic TV series.
The Plan. After being sent to a remote prison, three young men suffer under the watchful eye of their jailer and make a meticulous plan to escape.
Theeram. An auto rickshaw driver harbors a deep affection for a young woman, but his troubled past threatens to stand between them.
Big Bear. The alcohol-fueled high jinks of a bachelor party go haywire when the buddies of an ill-fated groom abduct his fiancée's new lover.
Accomplice. Traverse the globe with the world's top riders as they pedal through rugged terrain and majestic locations in this visual homage to the bicycle.
Girl's Revenge. After a sex video subjects her friend to mockery and bullying, a transfer student sets out to reveal the truth as campus secrets come to light.
Term Life. After a botched job, a heist mastermind must run from gangsters and stay alive long enough for his daughter to benefit from his life insurance policy.

titulo: Joan Didion: The Center Will Not Hold
texto: Joan Didion: The Center Will Not Hold. Literary icon Joan Didion reflects on her remarkable career and personal struggles in this intimate documentary directed by her nephew, Griffin Dunne.
The Tour. Miloš Knor brings comedians Lukáš Pavlásek, Tomáš Matonoha, Ester Kočičková, Michal Kavalčík and Richard Nedvěd on a tour around the Czech Republic.
دفعة القاهرة. A group of women leaves Kuwait to attend university in Cairo, embarking on personal journeys filled with romance and self-discovery.
Murder Maps. Dramatic reenactments paired with archival sources artfully illustrate how police brought some of Britain's most infamous killers to justice.
In Family We Trust. When the head of the lucrative family business passes away, his will leaves the clan at extreme odds.
Sayed the Servant. While running from the law, Sayed begins to work as a house servant to a wealthy family, whose divorced daughter enlists his help in a marriage scheme.

titulo: Gringo: The Dangerous Life of John McAfee
texto: Gringo: The Dangerous Life of John McAfee. Tech tycoon John McAfee made millions from his anti-virus software. Now, he may be best known for his bizarre and scandalous lifestyle.
Be Here Now. Trace the brave journey of actor Andy Whitfield, who received a devastating cancer diagnosis while starring in the series "Spartacus: Blood and Sand."
Flipped. Bryce and Juli first meet as children, with Juli having a crush on Bryce. As they mature, it appears their bond may blossom into something more.

titulo: Memories of a Murderer: The Nilsen Tapes
texto: Memories of a Murderer: The Nilsen Tapes. Serial killer Dennis Nilsen narrates his life and horrific crimes via a series of chilling audiotapes recorded from his jail cell.
One-Way to Tomorrow. Two strangers cross paths on a train en route to Izmir, bonding over their turbulent — and unexpectedly intertwined — romantic pasts.
It's Bruno!. An old-school Brooklyn native devotes his days to caring for his adorable dog, Bruno – and making sure the neighbors show his pooch the proper respect.
Gnome Alone. After moving into a new house with her mom, high schooler Chloe discovers a troupe of talking garden gnomes who need her help saving the world.
Varane Avashyamund. At an apartment complex, the lives of a mother, a daughter seeking an arranged marriage, a military retiree and a young man become intertwined.
The Irishman: In Conversation. Join director Martin Scorsese as he sits down with stars Robert De Niro, Al Pacino and Joe Pesci for an intimate, intriguing look inside "The Irishman."
Residue. A young screenwriter returns to his hometown to write a script based on his childhood and discovers his neighborhood has been gentrified.
The Great Raid. In World War II, a battalion goes on a daring rescue mission to liberate the Americans and Filipinos who've been captured by the Japanese.
